About Us:

### ***Specialized Care for the Patients Who Need It Most.***

NeuroPsychiatric Hospitals (NPH) is dedicated to providing unparalleled service to our patients, team members, physicians, and families. We dare to do things differently, bringing together compassionate care, specialized expertise, and an interdisciplinary approach to meet the unique needs of those we serve. It is this commitment that distinguishes NPH as the healthcare provider of choice.

As a national leader in behavioral healthcare, NPH specializes in caring for patients with acute psychiatric and complex medical needs. Our hospitals provide patient-centered care through an interdisciplinary, multi-specialty approach, ensuring our patients receive the specialized support they need when they need it most.

With locations in Indiana, Michigan, Texas, Ohio, and Arizona, we are expanding access to our unique model of care across the United States. Join NPH and become part of a team that is daring to do things differently and making a lasting difference in the lives of our patients, families, and communities every day.

Overview:

NeuroPsychiatric Hospitals is looking for a Director of Quality and Risk at our **Huber Heights, OH** location. NPH is the national leader in providing medical and neurobehavioral care to patients in acute psychiatric distress. You will be joining a team of rock star staff who provide exceptional, patient-centered care and understand our patients are always our number one priority! The Director of Quality supports the implementation and monitoring of the quality assurance measurements and audits, and assists in improving patient safety processes throughout the hospital through coordinating and engaging in activities to proactively promote implementation of evidence based best practices and resolve deficiencies; plans, develops, and directs system activities and protocols across NeuroPsychiatric Hospitals; helps to prepare NPH facilities for surveys by accrediting and licensing agencies; serves as a resource to all departments and personnel.

**Benefits of joining NPH as a Director of Quality and Risk**

* Competitive pay rates
* Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
* NPH 401(k) plan with up to 4% Company match
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP) Programs
* Generous PTO and Time Off Policy
* Special tuition offers through Capella University
* Work/life balance with great professional growth opportunities
* Employee Discounts through LifeMart

Responsibilities:

* Implements and monitors quality goals and objectives to measure the organization’s processes and outcomes while administering programs that focus on improved outcomes of patient care or patient safety.
* Interacts with physicians, nurses, department managers, supervisors, and any/all other staff members to provide resource information and identify new opportunities to improve service and reduce costs.
* Generates effectual quality related policies and procedures for the department and hospital that ensures compliance with JC, OSHA, CDC, CMS and other county, state, and federal regulatory agencies.
* Prepares reports, presentations and statistical data that go to the Quality Assurance and Performance Improvement Committee Meetings, facility's administration and other committees as needed. Analyzes data to identify trends and resource utilization for use in optimizing compliance.
* Assists with the annual assessment of the quality control programs from the prior year activities.
* Investigates incidents within the facility and coordinates with the Corporate Quality team to complete the root cause analysis and develop action plans to prevent incidents in the future.
* Establish a structure to ensure that patient care activities are addressed in a coordinated manner involving quality improvement.
* Prepares the agenda for the Quality Council Committee meetings and holds regularly scheduled meetings.
* Provides educational offerings for orientation and on-going in-services.
* Performs mortality reviews in conjunction with the mortality committee and holds regularly scheduled mortality committee meetings.
* Ensures all staff receive proper education on new or revised state and/ or federal regulations or Joint Commission standards.
* Participates in Multi-disciplinary patient centered case conferences, as appropriate.
* Assess and evaluate patients with infections and monitor patient outcomes on an ongoing basis.
* Initiates follow-up on employee/patient exposures to communicable diseases.
* Participates in root-cause analysis, sentinel events, adverse events and identifies trends as directed by regulation. Recommends ways to redesign systems for improvements if needed.
* Oversee Patient Advocacy program.
* Establishes/maintains good relationships with COO, CEO and DON’s and department leaders to promote a cooperative and constructive environment for improvement.
* Promote “Quality is everyone’s business” to gain support, understanding and ownership among staff.
* Other duties as may be assigned.
* Complies with hospital expectations regarding ethical behavior and standards of conduct.
* Complies with federal and hospital requirements in the areas of protected health information & patient privacy.
* Understands and adheres to NPH’s compliance standards as they appear in NPH’s Corporate Compliance Policy, Code of Conduct and Conflict of Interest Policy.
* Keeps abreast of all pertinent federal, state and hospital regulations, laws and policies as they presently exist and as they change or are modified.
* Performs other duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

* Bachelor's Degree in healthcare field or pertinent program required. Master's Degree preferred.
* 3+ years of relevant healthcare quality and risk management experience. Prior leadership experience preferred.
* Excellent verbal communication skills necessary in order present quality reports.
* Maintain effective contacts with a variety of Hospital Personnel.
* Professional knowledge of clinical practice, leadership, performance improvement and research statistics in order to conduct surveillance and prepare related reports at a level normally acquired through the completion of a Bachelor’s degree in related field.

Travel is Required. You will Support 5- Divisions. Must Reside in Utah, Idaho, Nevada, North Carolina, Virginia, Alaska or in the Nashville, TN area.

Job Summary and Qualifications

The Group Quality Director is responsible for implementation of the Laboratory Service Line quality and performance improvement programs for our National Group. This position applies quality and performance improvement approaches to identify and quantify improvement opportunities, facilitate and organization process improvement efforts, drive improvement, and measure outcomes. This role supervises Quality Coordinators in assigned divisions. You will be responsible for laboratory regulatory agency accreditation preparedness, tracking and reporting of specific information; auditing and analysis of processes and systems; statistical analysis of data; formulation of recommendations; and creation of written and verbal reports. * Partner with leaders to identify and coordinate implementation of continual improvement projects to improve quality performance.

Shirley Ryan AbilityLab is the global leader in physical medicine and rehabilitation for adults and children with the most severe, complex conditions. By joining our team, you’ll be part of our life-changing mission and vision. You’ll contribute to an innovative, multifaceted culture that is second to none — one that embraces collaboration, excellence, discovery and compassion. You’ll play a role in something that’s never been done before as we integrate science and clinical care to help patients achieve better, faster outcomes — as we Advance Human Ability, together.

**Job Description Summary**

The Director, Quality Improvement provides strategic leadership, oversight, and operational direction for quality improvement, regulatory readiness, accreditation compliance, and performance improvement initiatives across the Shirley Ryan AbilityLab system of care, inclusive of the Alliances. This role partners closely with clinical, operational, and administrative leaders to foster a culture of continuous improvement, patient safety, accountability, and high reliability in alignment with organizational goals and Envision 2030 priorities. 
 
The Director leads enterprise quality improvement initiatives, coordinates accreditation and regulatory readiness activities, advances data-informed decision-making, and supports ongoing compliance with applicable standards and requirements, including CARF, The Joint Commission, CMS, and other regulatory bodies. The Director serves as a key advisor and partner to clinical, operational, and administrative leaders to advance quality outcomes, patient safety, operational effectiveness, and organizational excellence.

**Job Description**

**The Director, Quality Improvement will:**

 

* Provide leadership and direction for quality improvement, performance improvement, accreditation, and regulatory readiness programs across the Shirley Ryan AbilityLab system of care, with initial focus at the flagship hospital
* Develop and lead quality and performance improvement initiatives utilizing evidence-based methodologies and frameworks to advance regulatory compliance, patient outcomes, and operational excellence across the Shirley Ryan AbilityLab system of care, with initial focus at the flagship hospital.
* Partner with leaders to align quality initiatives with strategic organizational priorities and Envision 2030 goals.
* Promote a culture of continuous improvement, transparency, accountability, and interdisciplinary collaboration.
* Oversee the identification, development, tracking, analysis, and reporting of key quality, patient safety, operational, and regulatory performance measures. Identify trends, risks, and opportunities for improvement.
* Collaborate with leaders and teams to identify opportunities for improvement and implement sustainable corrective action plans.
* Lead the annual development, evaluation, and update of the organization's Quality Assurance and Performance Improvement (QAPI) Plan and support ongoing monitoring of organizational performance against established priorities.
* Support departments in developing measurable goals, dashboards, and improvement plans to drive organizational performance.
* Direct organizational accreditation and regulatory readiness efforts, including preparation for CARF, The Joint Commission, CMS, and other applicable surveys and reviews.
* Maintain knowledge of evolving regulatory and accreditation standards and assess and communicate organizational impacts, risks, and recommended actions to leadership.
* Partner with operational and clinical leaders to ensure policies, procedures, workflows, and practices align with regulatory requirements and best practices.
* Oversee regulatory and accreditation survey response activities, corrective action plans, and ongoing monitoring to ensure timely and sustained compliance.
* Oversee the development and presentation of quality and performance reports, dashboards, and executive-level analyses to support organizational decision-making.
* Oversee the development and presentation of quality and performance reports, dashboards, and executive-level analyses that provide meaningful insights, support organizational accountability, and inform leadership decision-making.
* Serve as a subject matter expert and resource for quality improvement, accreditation, regulatory readiness, and performance improvement methodologies.
* Partner with leaders, physicians, clinicians, and operational teams to build organizational capability and accountability for quality, patient safety, and performance improvement.
* Develop and facilitate training, education, and communication strategies related to accreditation standards, regulatory requirements, and quality initiatives.
* Represent Quality and Safety on organizational committees, councils, and interdisciplinary teams as assigned.
* Perform all other duties that may be assigned in the best interest of the Shirley Ryan AbilityLab.

**Reporting Relationships**

* Reports directly to the Executive Director, Quality and Safety.
* Provides leadership and oversight to assigned quality, accreditation, regulatory, and performance improvement staff.

**Knowledge, Skills & Abilities Required**

* Master's degree in healthcare administration, business administration, public health, nursing, allied health or a related healthcare field required.
* Minimum of seven years of progressively responsible experience in healthcare quality improvement, accreditation, regulatory compliance, patient safety, or performance improvement, within a hospital, rehabilitation, or complex healthcare environment. .
* Relevant quality, patient safety, accreditation, or healthcare certification (e.g., CPHQ, CPPS) is required or obtained within two years of hire.
* Comprehensive knowledge of healthcare quality and performance improvement methodologies, accreditation standards, and regulatory requirements, with demonstrated experience leading accreditation and regulatory readiness activities. Knowledge of CARF, The Joint Commission, CMS, and other applicable healthcare regulatory and accreditation requirements.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with demonstrated ability to interpret complex quality, patient safety, operational and regulatory data and translate findings into actionable recommendations.
* Exceptional communication, facilitation, and relationship-building skills, with demonstrated ability to collaborate with and influence physicians, clinical leaders, operational leaders, and other stakeholders across all levels of the organization.
* Demonstrated project and change management capabilities, including the ability to lead complex, cross-functional initiatives from planning thru implementation and sustained adoption.

**Working Conditions**

* Normal office environment with little or no exposure to dust or extreme temperature undefined

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this classification. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of personnel so classified.

**Pay Range:**

$116,700.00 - $193,800.00

record.EMPLOYER_PRIMARY_BUSINESS:
POSITION SUMMARY
 
 
Will provide strategic leadership, direction, and oversight of the Laguna Healthcare Corporation (LHC) Compliance, Quality Risk Programs, encompassing all clinical, administrative, financial, and medical practice plan functions. This position is responsible for designing, implementing, and continuously improving enterprise-wide programs that ensure adherence to all federal, state, tribal, and accreditation standards. Serve as the primary authority on compliance matters, leads risk mitigation efforts, manages investigations, and champions a culture of ethics, accountability, and transparency. The Director collaborates with leadership, providers, and staff to promote a culture of continuous improvement, patient safety, and accountability. They oversee performance improvement initiatives, incident reporting systems, compliance activities, and risk mitigation strategies to enhance patient outcomes and organizational effectiveness. This position also plays a critical role in integrating culturally responsive care into quality frameworks, supporting health equity, and ensuring services reflect the values, traditions, and needs of the Tribal population served.
 
 
ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS
 
 

* Develop, implement, and oversee LHC’s Compliance, Quality Risk programs, policies, and procedures related to standards of conduct; healthcare laws; billing and reimbursement; fraud, waste, and abuse prevention; privacy and security; quality improvement and other compliance risk areas.
* Lead and facilitate internal committees to drive strategic planning for these programs, setting long- and short-term goals, operational plans, and performance measures.
* Conduct organization-wide quality and risk assessments to identify, prioritize, and mitigate compliance risks and improve overall patient outcomes.
* Monitor compliance with healthcare laws, CMS/OIG regulations, HIPAA/HITECH, and Tribal requirements.
* Oversee sanction screening of employees, contractors, and vendors; ensure organization-wide training on sanction monitoring processes. Ensure credentialing, privileging and provider enrollment program is effective.
* Lead internal audits and compliance reviews to ensure adherence to payer rules, regulatory standards, and organizational policies.
* Develop, in collaboration with the CMO, clinical care guidelines, as well as process and system guidelines.
* Manage confidential reporting channels, including the LHC Compliance Hotline, ensuring proper documentation, investigation, and resolution.
* Conduct or supervise compliance investigations; ensure/coordinate corrective actions with HR, legal counsel, leadership, and managers.
* Serve as the organizational liaison with regulatory agencies during audits, investigations, and compliance inquiries.
* Lead and mentor others in root cause analysis (RCA), healthcare failure mode and effects analysis (FMEA) and hazard vulnerability analysis (HVA) teams. Summarize risk management and patient safety data for appropriate evaluation and risk trend analysis.
* Maintain detailed records of compliance efforts, investigative outcomes, and corrective action plans.
* Provide written and verbal compliance reports to executive management, internal Quality Committee, the Board Compliance Committee and the LHC Board of Directors.
* Develop and administer a robust, organization-wide compliance training and education program in conjunction managers and the HR department.
* Lead communication initiatives to promote compliance awareness, ethical conduct, quality management and transparent reporting.
* Provide ongoing consultation to staff and leadership on regulatory requirements and performance improvement measures.
* Develop and coordinate processes to monitor quality of care. Identify opportunities to improve patient care, treatment and services by assisting to implement standard work.
* Oversee accreditation preparation for review by regulatory agencies including AAAHC and/or Joint Commission, educate, and assist department supervisors to maintain appropriate policies and procedures to fulfill requirements and regulations.
* Develop, monitor, and manage department budget.
* Supervise and direct staff and consultants and ensure adequate systems, training and tools to support program goals achievement, performance management and corrective action.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
 
 
Five (5) years of progressive experience in healthcare compliance, quality or related healthcare roles. Bachelor Degree in Finance/Accounting, Business, Public or Healthcare Administration or related field of study from an accredited college or university. Master's Degree preferred.
 
 
Certified Professional Compliance Officer (CPCO) preferred, Certified in Healthcare Compliance (CHC), Certified in Healthcare Privacy Compliance (CHPC), or Certified Compliance Ethics Professional (CCEP) or equivalent compliance certification, or eligible for and certification obtained within 12 months as condition of hire. Quality Management certification preferred.
 
 
MANDATORY KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, ABILITIES and COMPETENCIES with proficiency levels
 
 
Ethical Integrity Professionalism — Advanced
 
 
1. Demonstrates unwavering commitment to confidentiality, transparency, and ethical conduct.
 
 
2. Consistently models organizational values and establishes an ethical compliance culture.
 
 
3. Guides organizational decision-making through an ethics-centered approach.
 
 
Regulatory Compliance Expertise — Advanced
 
 
1. Interprets and applies federal, state, and Tribal healthcare regulations with precision.
 
 
2. Advises leadership on complex regulatory issues and emerging compliance risks.
 
 
3. Ensures organizational alignment with OIG, CMS, HIPAA/HITECH, and other regulatory standards.
 
 
Analytical Critical Thinking — Advanced
 
 
1. Uses advanced analytical methods to identify trends, risks, and system vulnerabilities.
 
 
2. Evaluates complex scenarios, synthesizes large volumes of information, and provides clear recommendations.
 
 
3. Leads continuous improvement initiatives using data-driven insights.
 
 
Investigation Problem-Solving — Advanced
 
 

* Conducts or oversees thorough investigations into compliance concerns.
* Demonstrates strong evidence analysis skills and draws objective, well-supported conclusions.
* Designs and monitors corrective action plans to ensure sustainable resolution

Leadership Influence — Advanced
 
 
1. Leads cross-functional teams and committees with confidence and clarity.
 
 
2. Influences organizational behavior through effective communication, coaching, and ethical leadership.
 
 
3. Builds trust and credibility with executives, clinical leaders, and staff.
 
 
Communication Interpersonal Effectiveness — Advanced
 
 
1. Clearly communicates complex regulatory concepts to varied audiences.
 
 
2. Prepares high-quality written reports and delivers professional presentations.
 
 
3. Maintains strong interpersonal relationships across diverse stakeholder groups.
 
 
Training Education Development — Intermediate to Advanced
 
 
1. Designs tailored compliance training programs for all workforce levels.
 
 
2. Assesses training effectiveness and adjusts content to address knowledge gaps.
 
 
3. Promotes consistent awareness of compliance responsibilities.
 
 
Project Program Management — Intermediate to Advanced
 
 
1. Manages multiple projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines.
 
 
2. Develops strategic and operational plans for the Compliance Program.
 
 
3. Implements structured processes for tracking progress and outcomes.
 
 
Risk Management Continuous Improvement — Advanced
 
 
1. Conducts comprehensive risk assessments and ongoing monitoring activities.
 
 
2. Identifies compliance vulnerabilities and implements preventative strategies.
 
 
3. Leads continuous improvement efforts across systems, policies, and internal controls.
 
 
Technical Systems Proficiency — Intermediate
 
 
1. Utilizes compliance software, databases, and Microsoft Office applications effectively.
 
 
2. Works collaboratively with IT and privacy teams to support data security practices.
 
 
3. Applies technology solutions to enhance documentation, reporting, and workflow efficiency.
 
 
PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS
 
 
In performance of their respective tasks and duties, an employee of Laguna Healthcare Corporation is expected to conform to the following:
 
 
1. Fully uphold all principles of confidentiality and patient care.
 
 
2. Adhere to all professional and ethical behavior standards of the healthcare industry.
 
 
3. Maintain all licensures and certifications required of position.
 
 
4. Interact in an honest, trustworthy and respectful manner with patients, employees, visitors and vendors.
 
 
5. Participate in leadership and/or board meetings, departmental staff meetings, quality management activities and educational programs as required.
 
 
6. Comply with Laguna Healthcare Corporation policies and procedures.
 
 
**7. Demonstrate and comply with LHC values:** COMPASSION, HONESTY, ACCOUNTABILITY, RESPECT AND TRUST.
 
 
8. Maintain a valid, insurable driver’s license.
 
 
TRIBAL PREFERENCE
 
 
LHC will apply “Indian Preference” as an employment criterion and not a “racial classification.” The Laguna Healthcare Corporation has implemented a Tribal Preference in Employment Policy. Pursuant to this Policy, applicants who possess the knowledge, skills, and abilities required by this position, and who are enrolled members of the Pueblo of Laguna will be given primary preference in hiring and employment for this position. Members of other Federally recognized Indian Tribes will be given secondary preference for hiring and employment after providing proof of Tribal membership.
 
 
CONFIDENTIALITY
 
 
All employees must fully uphold all principles of confidentiality. This position will have access to sensitive information and a breach of these principles will be grounds for immediate termination
 
 
BACKGROUND INVESTIGATION
 
 
This position may be subject to a criminal history background check, a suitability background check and/or a credit report check. In addition, some positions are subject to a more extensive background check to ensure compliance with Public Law 101-630 Indian Child Protection and Family Violence Prevention Act. Candidates must be able to successfully pass all required background checks to qualify for this position.
 
 
DRUG SCREENING
 
 
All applicants must successfully pass a pre-employment drug screening prior to beginning employment and will be subject to random drug testing
 
 
**Disclaimer:** The information on this position description has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performance by employees in this position. It is not designed to contain, or be interpreted as, a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications required of employees assigned to this position. Employees will be asked to perform other duties as needed.

At Taconic Biosciences, operational excellence fuels scientific discovery. We're seeking an experienced Operations Planning leader to strengthen the connection between commercial demand and operational execution, ensuring our teams deliver exceptional results for customers worldwide. If you're passionate about strategic planning, continuous improvement, and leading high-performing teams, this is your opportunity to make a lasting impact.

**The Location:** This role is a primarily at home/remote but will have ad hoc needs to come onsite. Average monthly time on-site is 5% - 10%. A candidate residing within 2 hours of Albany, NY or Germantown, NY is preferred but not required.

**The Pay Range**: $120,000 - $170,000 annually. *Exact annual base salary may vary based on several factors. These factors include, but are not limited to: geographic location, experience, training, education, and local market conditions.*

**The Schedule:** Monday - Friday, core business hours.

**What we offer:**

* Insurance within 30 days or less which includes options for medical, dental, vision, pet insurance and more!
* 20 days paid time off plus 6 additional holidays and 1 floating holiday
* Work life balance
* 401(k) plan with up to 4% employer match
* Tuition reimbursement
* Career advancement opportunities
* Commitment to training and providing you with the skills you need for success
* All employees receive access to 24/7 telemedicine (including mental health), short- and long-term disability and life insurance

**The Role:** 
The role's objective is to strengthen alignment between Operations and the Commercial areas, making sure internal and external customers' expectations are met, as well as constantly improving efficiency & cost to achieve business financial commitments. 
 
**Core Responsibilities:**

* Manage and develop the SIOP (Sales, Inventory & Operations Planning) process across the business
* Ensure optimal communication among Commercial & Operations regarding demand and production commitments
* Develop and maintain updated Operational Capacity numbers, and timely detect capacity expansion needs
* Coordinator efforts to develop Operation's yearly budgets (AOP) and forecast updates
* Work closely with global Commercial Demand stakeholders (sales, marketing, R&D), Procurement, Animal Production and Logistics to align Operation's resources to demand
* Identify and highlight to OLT (Operations Leadership Team) any short-, mid-, and long-term resource needs based on commercial demand plans and changes
* Develop a LEAN Production culture that is constantly looking for improvement results in all metrics that matter considering, but not limited to: People, Safety, Quality, Animal Welfare, Customer Services and Cost
* Detect, develop and execute continuous improvement projects to optimize the use of Operation's resources; (5Ms - Men & Women, Machines, Materials, Minutes (time and schedules), Methods)
* Develop and implement success metrics to drive accountability and continuous improvement
* Lead, manage and develop all members of the Operations Planning Team

**Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree in industrial engineering or similar required, Master's degree is desirable
* Experience in the management of a professional staff and senior-level decision making
* Extensive experience in a specialized field, with responsibility for strategic technical direction, high-impact problem-solving, or enterprise-level initiatives
* 10+ years of relevant experience and/or training required
* Experience in Industrial Production/Manufacturing. Laboratory animal production would be desirable.
* Skill in designing, implementing, and coordinating projects.
* Experience in making strategic decisions or recommendations for improving or changing organizational policies, procedures and processes.
* Structured, well organized analytical thinking.
* 10+ years in any area of Industrial Operations areas.
* 6+ years in Production / Manufacturing
* 5+ years leading teams & experience in Change Management
* 3+ years in S&OP process including IBP (Integrated Business Planning) 
 Other Desirable Experience & Competencies:
* 3+ years managing Operations / Manufacturing Costs
* 3+ Years Project management experience (PMO)
* Knowledge and Practical experience with Forecasting Statistical Methodologies
* APICS certification
* AI experienced applied to S&OP
* Multi site / Global responsibility.

**Allergen Disclosure:**

Due to the nature of the work performed at Taconic, employees may be exposed to allergens in the workplace, even if their positions do not involve the direct handling of animals or animal bedding. While individuals with preexisting allergies and/or asthma may be particularly sensitive to these exposures, anyone can experience a reaction.

**Physical Requirements & Work Environment:**

The work is sedentary. Typically, the employee may sit comfortably to do the work, with some walking; standing; bending; carrying of items such as papers, books, small parts; driving an automobile; etc. No special physical demands are required to perform the work.

**About Us:** 
With a history of over 70 years of excellence, Taconic Biosciences is a global team of the best problem solvers in the industry. We partner with our clients to develop winning research strategies that accelerate the discoveries for prevention and treatment of disease.

Taconic employees all over the world show up every day to deliver the best solutions for our clients while caring for ourselves, each other, and especially our animals. If you are a respectful, compassionate individual with a can-do attitude and a desire to do the right thing, we want you to join us!

**Better Together at Taconic** 
Awareness, Action, & Respect. Taconic Biosciences is taking an active and intentional role in fostering a company culture that values and appreciates the uniqueness of all individuals, by promoting fairness and equity. Being you is what allows you to bring your best self to work. We are committed to making Taconic a safe and fair workplace for everyone. We are better together. 
 
Taconic Biosciences is an equal-opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status, and all other categories protected by law.

* Proficient in using KPIs to track and improve production performance (yield, OEE, waste, etc.).

* Able to ensure compliance while maintaining efficient production flow.

* Capable of managing production schedules, labor allocation, and resource planning effectively.
* Strong prioritization skills in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

* Works well with cross-functional teams (QA, Maintenance, Supply Chain, R&D).

* Rapidly identifies root causes of operational issues and implements effective solutions.

* Proficient in ERP and production management systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle).
* Comfortable with Microsoft Excel and production reporting tools.

* Maintains a strong commitment to producing safe, high-quality food products.
* Ensures production meets internal and customer standards for consistency and specification.

* Promotes a culture of safety and enforces all workplace safety procedures.
* Proactively identifies risks and implements mitigation strategies.

**10. Adaptability & Resilience**

* Thrives in a dynamic production environment with changing demands.
* Maintains composure and performance under stress or operational setbacks.

### **Description**

We are seeking an experienced and highly skilled **Plant Manager** to oversee and manage all aspects of multi-site plant operations, ensuring efficient production, high-quality standards, and a safe working environment. 
 
The ideal candidate will have strong leadership skills, proven experience in managing manufacturing plants, and a thorough understanding of operational strategies, including safety, budgeting, and human resource management. The Plant Manager will also be responsible for ensuring production goals are met, maintaining plant facilities, and continuously improving processes to maximize efficiency

### **How You Will Help**

 

* Lead and manage daily operations of the manufacturing plant to meet production schedules, ensure product quality, and achieve on-time delivery.
* Partner with EHS to ensure safety, health, and environmental regulations, including local, state, and federal safety standards.
* Develop and implement strategic plans for operational efficiency, resource allocation, and process improvements.
* Manage plant budgets and financial statements, ensuring cost-effective operations while meeting financial goals.
* Maintain and upgrade plant facilities and equipment, ensuring they are in optimal working condition; oversee necessary repairs, replacements, and adjustments.
* Monitor production activities, ensuring adherence to quality standards and safety protocols, including the use of personal protective equipment (PPE).
* Collaborate with engineering, quality, and supply chain teams to optimize production processes and implement lean manufacturing principles.
* Create and foster a culture of accountability, teamwork, and continuous improvement, leading by example and building strong relationships with team members.
* Implement and monitor inventory management strategies, ensuring proper material flow and minimizing waste.
* Develop, mentor, and manage staff, providing training and development opportunities to enhance skills and performance.
* Ensure timely communication and coordination between departments to meet production targets and business objectives.
* Identify and resolve operational issues, making data-driven decisions to improve plant efficiency and productivity.
* Perform other duties as assigned by senior management
* Travel up to 10% domestically, including quarterly visits to company facilities in Pennsylvania and Texas to support project execution and cross-functional collaboration.

 

### **What You Will Bring**

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Operations Management, Engineering, or a related field.
* Experience working in a custom manufacturing environment, including knowledge of assembly, fabrication, welding, and machining processes
* A minimum of 10 years of experience in plant operations, with at least 5 years in a management role.
* Working knowledge of budgeting, strategic planning, and financial statements.
* Strong leadership abilities with proven experience in team building, decision-making, and people management.
* In-depth knowledge of manufacturing processes, equipment, and safety standards.
* Familiarity with lean manufacturing, supply chain management, and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to make data-driven decisions.
* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to lead cross-functional teams.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* MBA or advanced degree in a related field.
* Certification or experience with lean manufacturing, Six Sigma, or supply chain management.
* Working knowledge of industry codes and standards, including TOSHA and other health and safety regulations.

 

### **About Reliable Safety and Flow Corporation**

Bringing together more than 175 years of innovation, quality, and customer commitment under one name and one promise.

The company was forged in 1850, as American industry was being connected by pipe, valves, fittings, and the skilled people who knew how to put them in the right place. More than 175 years later, that heritage lives in ASC Engineered Solutions, a comprehensive pipe preparation, joining, hanging and flow-management portfolio supporting the people who build and maintain commercial buildings, industrial facilities, infrastructure, and critical systems. **Senior Manager – Reman & Refurb Operations**

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

The Senior Manager – Reman & Refurb Operations leads the development, execution, and growth of SANY America’s component remanufacturing and full-machine refurbishment operations. This position oversees shop performance, safety, quality, cost, inventory, suppliers, and dealer support while building a scalable, profitable operation that improves machine uptime and lifecycle value.

With current revenues over $500 million, SANY America continues to make strong progress and significant investments in the Americas market; the organization is now pursuing an aggressive growth strategy and is looking to move quickly beyond this initial platform and increase their market share.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Business Strategy & Operations**

* Develop and execute the U.S. remanufacturing and refurbishment roadmap, including future certified refurbished equipment programs.

* Direct production planning, technician utilization, shop capacity, workflows, turnaround times, and performance standards.

* Build and coach technical and operations teams, establishing clear ownership, training, and accountability.

**Remanufacturing & Refurbishment**

* Standardize machine inspection, teardown, repair, component replacement, testing, cosmetic restoration, and final acceptance.

* Expand viable remanufacturing offerings for engines, hydraulics, powertrain, electronics, and other high-value assemblies.

* Establish documented repair procedures, quality gates, testing standards, failure analysis, and corrective actions.

**Financial & Inventory Management**

* Own operating budgets, rebuild costs, labor standards, margin performance, scrap reduction, and repair-versus-replace decisions.

* Develop core return, valuation, salvage, used-component, and reman inventory controls to improve recovery and reduce working capital.

* Track operational and financial KPIs, including cycle time, capacity, first-pass quality, revenue, and profitability.

**Suppliers, Dealers & Cross-Functional Support**

* Manage outside rebuild suppliers and technical partners against quality, cost, warranty, and lead-time expectations.

* Partner with Service, Parts, Warranty, Product, Sales, Finance, and dealers to support customer uptime and refurbishment opportunities.

* Support certified refurbished equipment programs through condition grading, inspection documentation, and warranty coordination.

**Safety & Continuous Improvement**

* Maintain a safe, organized, compliant shop with appropriate PPE, equipment controls, and safe work practices.

* Implement Lean, 5S, standard work, visual management, root cause analysis, and ongoing process improvements.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, Supply Chain, Business, or related field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.

* 12+ years of progressive experience in remanufacturing, refurbishment, heavy equipment, automotive, industrial manufacturing, service operations, or a related field.

* 6+ years of direct people-management or operations-leadership experience.

* Strong understanding of engines, hydraulics, powertrain, electrical systems, and heavy equipment troubleshooting.

* Proven ability to manage production, quality, inventory, capacity, costs, KPIs, and financial performance.

* Strong communication, problem-solving, cross-functional leadership, and analytical skills.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience launching or expanding remanufacturing, machine rebuild, refurbishment, or certified pre-owned operations.

* Construction or off-highway equipment experience, including supplier and third-party rebuild partner management.

* Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, 5S, ERP, inventory, service, and warranty system experience.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT & PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS**

**OFFICE + OPERATIONS WORK ENVIRONMENT**

This role is primarily office-based with regular work in remanufacturing, refurbishment, and equipment service areas. Duties may involve extended computer use, standing, walking, and observing or inspecting heavy machinery, tools, and shop operations. Exposure to noise, moving equipment, and varying temperatures may occur. Required personal protective equipment (PPE) must be worn in designated areas, with or without reasonable accommodation.

**TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS**

Occasional travel to SANY facilities, suppliers, dealers, and customer sites as business needs require.

**COMPENSATION & BENEFITS**

Compensation will be competitive and commensurate with experience.

* Medical, dental, and vision

* Paid Time Off

* 401(k) savings plans

* Health Savings Account (HSA)

* Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs)

* Company paid STD and LTD benefits

* Life Insurance

* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY STATEMENT**

SANY America is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other protected status under applicable federal, state, or local law.

**DRUG AND ALCOHOL-FREE WORKPLACE NOTICE**

SANY America is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a drug and alcohol-free workplace consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws. Applicants may be required to complete pre-employment screenings, including drug and/or alcohol testing, as a condition of employment where permitted by applicable law. Testing requirements, employment practices, and workplace policies may vary based on work location, position responsibilities, business necessity, workplace safety considerations, customer requirements, contractual obligations, and applicable regulatory standards.

 

SANY America complies with applicable federal, state, and local laws relating to marijuana/cannabis use, including applicable medical and recreational marijuana laws where permitted. However, applicants and employees are prohibited from being impaired or under the influence of alcohol, illegal drugs, or other prohibited substances while working, operating Company vehicles or equipment, performing safety sensitive duties, conducting Company business, or while on Company property, consistent with applicable law.

 

Certain positions may be designated as safety sensitive or subject to additional regulatory, customer, contractual, operational, or workplace safety requirements and may require participation in pre-employment, random, reasonable suspicion, post-accident, return to duty, follow up, or other drug and/or alcohol testing programs in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

You will lead a team of up to 150 employees and be supported by Parklane’s shared services groups, including Engineering, Supply Chain, Human Resources, and Finance, so you can focus on running a safe, high-performing operation and setting the standard for how Parklane operates in Michigan.

**Key Responsibilities**

Site Leadership & Start-Up

* Lead the ramp-up of the new site, establishing operating rhythms, processes, and standards aligned with Parklane’s practices
* Develop and execute site plans and budgets in partnership with Finance and senior leadership
* Serve as the face of Parklane in the local community, with customers, vendors, and regulators

Operations & Production

* Direct day-to-day manufacturing, fabrication, assembly, and shipping activities to meet customer commitments
* Work with production scheduling and Supply Chain to balance capacity, labor, and material availability
* Drive continuous improvement and lean practices to improve throughput, reduce waste, and control cost
* Track and report on site KPIs, and act quickly on gaps to plan

Safety, Quality & Compliance

* Champion a safety-first culture and ensure compliance with OSHA, EPA, and applicable federal, state, and local requirements
* Partner with QHSE to implement and sustain Parklane’s quality management system and drive corrective actions to closure
* Maintain a clean, organized, audit-ready facility and well-maintained equipment

People Leadership

* Recruit, develop, and lead plant leaders, supervisors, and front-line teams, building a strong bench for a growing site
* Partner with Human Resources on hiring, onboarding, employee relations, performance management, and engagement
* Set clear expectations, coach for accountability, and recognize results in line with Parklane’s core values
* Build a positive, inclusive culture where employees feel safe, respected, and invested in the site’s success

Cross-Functional Collaboration

* Work closely with Engineering on product design, manufacturability, and technical issues
* Partner with Supply Chain on procurement, inventory, logistics, and supplier performance
* Collaborate with Finance on budgeting, cost control, and financial reporting
* Leverage shared services across the organization to support the site efficiently, and provide feedback to continuously improve that support

**Qualifications and Experience**

* Hands-on, accountable, and comfortable building structure in a fast-paced, evolving environment

Circle of Life is growing, and we have an opening for a Regional Director of Operations to join our team. This position will oversee and manage our New Mexico branches; Albuquerque, Gallup, Kirtland, Shiprock, and Zuni.

**Good for employees**

Circle of Life’s focus is creating a workplace where respect, appreciation and teamwork are the shared experiences of our team. We do good for our employees by collaborating on scheduling, a focus on wellbeing, a client-first directive, respecting and valuing every team member, having fun along with top industry compensation and benefits.

**Good deeds**

We also do good in our work. Our team of office and field staff care about each other and the clients we serve. We help one another. We care and provide for a wide range of patients with a focus on serving the underserved.

**Position duties include**

* Participate in the hiring and training of managers
* Organize and oversee the work and schedules of managers
* Conduct performance evaluations
* Handle discipline of employees as needed following company policy
* Establish quantitative and qualitative metrics, guidelines, and standards by which the company's efficiency and effectiveness can be evaluated (identify opportunities for improvement)
* Implement policies and procedures that will improve day-to-day operations
* Oversee office operations, ensuring each branch is reaching goals set by departmental and company leadership
* Monitors budget and revenue in each office to achieve financial objectives
* Communicates and explains new directives, policies/procedures to manager for change and meets with staff to explain changes, answer questions, and maintain morale
* Improve customer service and satisfaction
* Market current products to potential clients, families, case workers and potential referral sources
* Leads coordination and integration of efforts among homecare teams to produce smoother workflow and more cost-effective business processes
* Traveling is required

**Qualifications**

Qualified applicants will have 3 years of management experience, excellent verbal and written communication skills and interpersonal and customer service skills. Healthcare and/or home care experience preferred. The Regional Director of Operations oversees the day-to-day activities for their assigned branches, ensuring the organization is managed and performing efficiently and effectively. While carrying out the responsibilities of the position, ensure the values of servant-leadership, empathy, altruism, and integrity are evident in all actions and encounters.

**How good?**

* Positively change the lives of individuals and families in our communities
* Serve the underserved providing access to care for those who have been traditionally overlooked by the health care system
* Support a talented team of administrative and clinical professionals and be a part of a team that supports each other

**Full Benefits include**

* Medical, Dental, 401K, Paid Holidays, Top PTO Plan, Mileage, Flexible Schedules, Vision, Year-End Bonus

Tennessee Oncology, one of the nation’s largest, community-based cancer care specialists, is home to one of the leading clinical trial networks in the country. Established 1976 in Nashville, Tennessee Oncology’s mission remains unchanged: To provide access to high-quality cancer care and the expertise of clinical research for all patients, at convenient locations within their community and close to their home. Our growing network of physicians and locations is based on this mission. Tennessee Oncology is committed to advancing both the science of detection and targeted treatments, and to making these advances available to every patient. We believe caring for cancer patients is a privilege.

Why Join Us? We are looking for talented and highly-motivated individuals who demonstrate a natural desire to support the meaningful work of community oncologists and the patients we serve.

**Job Description:**

The Regional Director of Clinical Operations is responsible for directing, supervising, and coordinating staff and activities at multiple clinics to provide quality, cost-effective care. May also be responsible for business development and establishing/maintaining positive working relationships with community leaders and hospital leadership.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

* Supervises all Operations Managers**/**Regional Operations Managers for assigned region and others as directed.
* Manages daily operations at assigned clinic(s) and coordinates the work activities and schedules.
* Ensures provisions of safe, high-quality patient care by the staff.
* Evaluates performance and recommends candidates for hire, merit increases, promotions, and disciplinary actions.
* Ensures that office space, supplies, equipment, and assistance are provided and maintained appropriately for medical staff and patient care.
* Ensures that all business functions are operative and that all processes are effectively and efficiently in place. Identifies and implements process improvement changes. Creates goals for clinic operations and ensures that these goals are in line with organizational goals.
* Maximizes opportunities to manage operating costs.
* Works closely with Providers and MD Partners ensuring all clinic and company goals are met.
* Contributes to the writing and revision of company policies, procedures, job descriptions and competencies etc.
* Maintains an active and/or leadership role in company projects and initiatives and ensures implementation and integration in clinics.
* Oversees Regional Safety and Compliance for all governing agents in collaboration with other Managers and Directors to include but not limited to: OSHA, QOPI, PQRS, and Meaningful Use etc.
* Creates and maintains an environment of trust, integrity, open communication, teamwork and respect.
* Works collaboratively with vendors, contractors, building maintenance and others that interact with all regional clinics.
* Oversight of payroll for direct reports and Performance Excellence Plans.
* Responsible for mentoring, coaching and development of direct reports.
* Brainstorms action planning in an effort to improve scores of the Employee engagement survey.
* Works with managers of all clinics in reviewing and analyzing patient satisfaction and developing action plans for improvement.
* Has superior skills in building relationships with Providers.
* Relates well to all types of people using diplomacy and tact in team building.
* Regularly rounds in clinics to assure high visibility and develop trusting relationships with staff and to ensure validation that changes, and initiatives are fully engrained.
* Works collaboratively with department directors/leaders to achieve operational/projects initiatives, goals and outcomes.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES:

*Knowledge:*

* Knowledge of fiscal management and human resource management techniques.
* Knowledge of office management techniques and practices.

*Skills:*

* Excellent organizational and time management skills.
* Outstanding verbal and written communication skills.
* Setting, defining, assigning, monitoring, and evaluating outcomes of tasks and goals.

*Abilities:*

* Ability to clearly communicate and apply policies and principles to solve everyday problems and deal with a variety of situations.
* Ability to plan, exercise initiative, problem solve, make decisions.
* Ability to read, interpret, and apply clinic policies and procedures.
* Ability to identify problems and recommend solutions.
* Ability to establish priorities and coordinate work activities.
* Ability to manage financial information.

**EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:**

Bachelor’s degree in healthcare administration, business administration, nursing or related field. Prefer Master’s degree.

Prefer 3-5 years Oncology office management experience preferred, including at least 2 years in a clinic setting. Strongly prefer experience managing multiple locations

**About Us**

Born in 1993, Excelsia Injury Care’s mission is to restore quality of life through patient-centric care and support for those injured in motor vehicle or work-related accidents. With over 100 patient care centers across the Mid-Atlantic, Midwest, and Mountain West regions, our vision is to be the leading provider of injury care, setting the standard for excellence in every community we serve and expanding access to high-quality care nationwide.

At Excelsia, we deliver the full continuum of outpatient care within one seamless, connected system. Our diverse team of medical specialists offers a wide range of treatment services, covering medical, orthopedics, neurology, rehabilitation, diagnostic, and surgical. We are committed to supporting patients through personalized support, detailed documentation, and outcome-oriented care coordination to make the recovery process easier. With Excelsia, patients are never far from the care they need—with the compassion they deserve.

Founded on the values of respect and trustworthiness, we are committed to delivering services that adhere to the highest legal, regulatory, and ethical standards. As responsible corporate citizens, we integrate environmental, social, and governance (ESG) considerations into our business practices, ensuring that we positively impact the healthcare companies we serve, our employees, and the communities we reach.

**\*\*\*Please know this position requires 100% travel throughout our Greater Baltimore Market\*\*\***

**Job Duties**

* Leads their respective regions to ensure smooth operation of medical offices.
* Participate in the coordination of logistics (with the support of the Executive Assistant) for all provider and manager meetings.
* Act as a liaison between Compliance, BSO staff, and providers to ensure that audits and retraining are completed (e.g., dictation).
* Investigate patient complaints that are reported to Compliance related to operational issues.
* Assists in ensuring that operations tasks related to integrations are completed prior to the required milestone dates.
* Manages a variety of projects to be assigned by the market president.
* Hire, train, and provide development opportunities for nonclinical staff of medical offices.
* Act as an escalation point for clinical office managers and providers.
* Provide their teams with the data needed to have line of sight into the overall operational health of their assigned offices.
* Weekly onsite presence at all locations.
* Ensures financial and operational objectives of offices are realized.
* Ensure that each member within their region is performing all duties in his or her job description.
* Implement protocols identified by Compliant related to HIPAA, regulations, and company processes.
* Improve office processes and manage the implementations.
* Ensure financial and operational objectives of offices are realized.
* Monitor Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) daily and react to needs.
* Provide regular reporting in accordance with Excelsia standards.
* Conducts regularly scheduled one-on-one meetings with direct reports to provide support, address challenges, and foster professional growth.

* Leads recurring team meetings and ensures timely completion of annual performance reviews, delivering constructive feedback to support individual and team development.
* Lead with integrity by upholding our core values and ensuring that all operations align with legal, regulatory, and ethical standards. Foster a culture of corporate responsibility by incorporating Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) principles into business practices, positively impacting the patients we serve, our employees, and the communities we reach.
* Perform other duties and assignments as directed and/or as necessary.

##### **Minimum Requirements**

* High school Graduate or GED equivalent
* Bachelor’s degree in related field preferred
* Knowledge of advanced work-related subjects
* Successful completion of corporate orientation program
* Ongoing related continuing education participation
* Five or more years in a related supervisory capacity
* 1-2 years of medical experience in an administrative/legal/ physician office setting
* Previous computer skills to include (data entry, word perfect, etc.)

##### **Additional Skills/Competencies**

* Ability to maintain a strong confidentiality profile
* Ability to project a strong corporate image
* Ability to recognize emergency medical and non-medical situations
* Ability to identify and resolve customer relation problems
* Ability to identify and resolve clinical problems.
* Ability to remain calm in emergency situations
* Ability to form interpersonal relationships (i.e., establish rapport with others)
* Ability to manage time effectively by setting priorities
* Ability to anticipate problems before they arise.
* Ability to anticipate patient/physician/corporate needs
* Mathematical ability to perform required calculations.

##### **Physical/Mental Requirements**

* Ability to work flexible hours as required by job demands.
* May include some exposure to infection and injury
* Manual dexterity hand/eye coordination
* Able to lift a minimum of 10 pounds independently
* Able to perform frequent work with hand/wrist movement
* Prolonged sitting for up to 60% of time.

##### **Motor Vehicle Report Monitoring**

In the event Employee does not maintain the insurance coverage required under this Policy & Procedure, and/or does not maintain a valid license to operate a motor vehicle, that Employee shall not be eligible for mileage reimbursement and is barred from operating any motor vehicle in furtherance of Company business. Operating a motor vehicle in furtherance of Company business without a valid state-issued driver’s license to do so and/or maintain insurance of the type and amounts set forth herein shall subject the Employee to immediate disciplinary action up to and including termination.

**Why work for Excelsia Injury Care? We offer a competitive salary, a great and stable work environment as well as amazing benefit package! Offered Benefits include:**

* Medical, Dental and Vision plans through CareFirst with PPO And HSA options available the first of the month after your hire date.
* Rich leave benefits including PTO that is accrued starting on your first day of work, 8 company-recognized paid holidays plus a floating holiday, and 5 days of sick leave each calendar year.
* Employee Assistance Program, Earned Wage Access, and Employee Assistance Fund.
* Discounts on shopping and travel perks through WorkingAdvantage.
* 401(k) retirement plan with employer match.
* Paid training opportunities and Education Assistance Program.
* Employee Referral Bonus Program

**Diversity Statement**

Excelsia Injury Care is an equal opportunity employer. We commit to a policy of nondiscrimination and equal opportunity for all employees and qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, pregnancy or related medical conditions, age, national origin or ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic predisposition, marital, civil union or partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other consideration protected by federal, state or local laws.

Director of Operations / Multi-Unit Supervisor – McDonald's

**Company:** Sidor Ventures LLC dba McDonald's 
**Location:** Seminole County, Florida (Sanford, Oviedo, Winter Springs) 
**Position:** Full-Time | Multi-Unit Restaurant Leadership 
**Compensation:** Competitive base salary, performance-based bonus opportunities, and comprehensive benefits, including health insurance and a 401(k) with employer match.

**About Sidor Ventures**

Sidor Ventures is a growing McDonald's franchise organization operating four restaurants throughout Seminole County, Florida, and employing more than 200 team members.

We are building a high-performance organization centered on operational excellence, accountability, leadership development, and an exceptional customer experience.

As we continue expanding, we are seeking an exceptional, results-driven Director of Operations / Multi-Unit Supervisor to lead restaurant performance, develop our General Managers, and help drive the next phase of our organization's growth.

**This is an opportunity to play a significant leadership role in a growing franchise organization, work directly with ownership, and help shape the future of the business.**

**Position Overview**

The Director of Operations / Multi-Unit Supervisor is responsible for overseeing the operational, financial, and people performance of multiple McDonald's restaurants.

We are seeking a highly motivated, hands-on leader who can develop high-performing General Managers, establish consistent operating standards, improve restaurant profitability, and build a strong leadership pipeline.

The ideal candidate combines exceptional operational knowledge with strong financial acumen, sound judgment, and a proven ability to lead through others.

This position works directly with ownership and will play a critical role in strengthening our existing restaurants while supporting future expansion.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide leadership and operational oversight across multiple McDonald's restaurants.
* Ensure consistent execution of McDonald's brand standards, Quality, Service, and Cleanliness (QSC).
* Drive measurable improvements in service times, order accuracy, customer satisfaction, and overall restaurant performance.
* Conduct regular restaurant visits, operational assessments, and performance reviews.
* Identify operational challenges, develop corrective action plans, and ensure sustained improvement.
* Maintain strong food safety, workplace safety, and regulatory compliance standards.
* Establish consistent operating procedures and accountability across the organization.

**Financial Performance & Profitability**

* Take ownership of restaurant-level financial performance, profitability, and controllable expenses.
* Analyze restaurant P&Ls, sales trends, guest counts, labor performance, food costs, and operational metrics.
* Partner with General Managers to develop accurate sales forecasts, labor schedules, and operating budgets.
* Identify opportunities to improve sales growth, operational efficiency, and restaurant profitability.
* Establish clear performance objectives and hold restaurant leadership accountable for results.
* Monitor inventory controls, waste, cash management, and other key financial processes.
* Develop and execute action plans to address underperforming restaurants.

**Leadership Development & Talent Management**

* Directly coach, mentor, and develop restaurant General Managers.
* Establish high expectations for leadership, accountability, communication, and operational execution.
* Identify and develop high-potential managers for future General Manager and multi-unit leadership positions.
* Partner with ownership on recruiting, succession planning, and organizational development.
* Build a strong leadership bench capable of supporting future restaurant acquisitions and new restaurant openings.
* Foster a positive, professional, results-oriented culture across the organization.
* Conduct regular GM performance evaluations and leadership development discussions.

**Strategic Execution & Accountability**

* Work directly with ownership to establish and execute organizational priorities.
* Lead regular business reviews with General Managers, using operational and financial data to drive decisions.
* Ensure timely follow-through on operational initiatives, performance improvement plans, and company standards.
* Proactively identify business risks and opportunities and recommend solutions.
* Support restaurant acquisitions, new restaurant openings, and organizational expansion.
* Maintain consistent, transparent communication with ownership regarding restaurant performance, personnel, and operational priorities.
* Demonstrate professionalism, integrity, sound judgment, and a strong sense of ownership.

**Qualifications - Required**

* Minimum 5 years of progressive restaurant leadership experience, including significant responsibility for high-volume restaurant operations.
* Demonstrated success leading General Managers or multiple restaurant management teams.
* Proven ability to improve operational performance, profitability, and leadership effectiveness.
* Strong understanding of restaurant P&Ls, labor management, food costs, forecasting, and financial controls.
* Exceptional leadership, coaching, communication, and organizational skills.
* Ability to interpret performance data, identify root causes, and implement effective action plans.
* Willingness to maintain a consistent, hands-on presence across restaurant locations.
* Ability to travel regularly between restaurants throughout Seminole County, Florida.

**Strongly Preferred**

* Current or previous McDonald's Area Supervisor, Operations Supervisor, or Director of Operations experience.
* Extensive McDonald's restaurant operations background, including General Manager experience.
* Hamburger University training and relevant McDonald's leadership development.
* Experience overseeing multiple high-volume restaurants generating $3 million–$5 million or more in annual sales per location.
* Strong familiarity with McDonald's operating systems, operational metrics, and performance standards.
* Demonstrated success developing General Managers and building management succession pipelines.
* Experience supporting new restaurant openings, acquisitions, or multi-unit organizational growth.

**Compensation & Benefits**

Sidor Ventures offers a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to attract, reward, and retain exceptional operational leaders.

Our benefits include:

* Competitive base salary
* Performance-based bonus opportunities
* Employer-sponsored health insurance
* 401(k) retirement plan with employer match
* Paid time off
* Professional development and leadership training
* Significant opportunities for professional growth as the organization expands

Specific compensation and benefit details will be discussed during the recruiting process.

**Career Growth**

Sidor Ventures is focused on building a strong, scalable restaurant organization with a long-term commitment to growth.

We are seeking a leader who wants more than a traditional supervisory position. This individual will have the opportunity to help shape our operating culture, develop future leaders, and contribute directly to the organization's expansion.

As we grow, the scope of this position will have the potential to expand alongside the business.

**If you are an accomplished multi-unit restaurant leader who takes pride in developing exceptional teams, driving measurable results, and building a successful organization, we would welcome the opportunity to speak with you.**

*Sidor Ventures is an equal opportunity employer.*

Pay: $100,000.00 - $150,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Employee discount
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Professional development assistance
* Relocation assistance
* Tuition reimbursement
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

Building on nearly 50 years of success, we deliver Payload & Protection Systems, Aero/Hydrodynamic Interstage Systems, and Propulsion & Launch Systems to more than 80 prime contractors supporting over 130 space and defense programs.

The Director of Quality, Defense is responsible for overseeing all quality activities, personnel, systems, and performance associated with Defense programs across multiple Karman Space & Defense operating sites. This role provides strategic and operational leadership to ensure all Defense hardware, assemblies, and services meet or exceed contractual, regulatory, and customer requirements. 
 
This position will manage the Defense Quality Engineering organization, supports execution of Defense programs, and ensures consistent application of quality standards and tools across the sector. This leader works in close partnership with the Enterprise Director of Quality to align each site's AS9100 compliant QMS with the emerging enterprise quality architecture and to transition multiple Defense sites toward a unified enterprise certification. 
 
This role is critical in driving disciplined execution, continuous improvement, product integrity, and customer satisfaction within the Defense market segment.

Reports to Vice President, Defense. Functional Partnership with Enterprise Director of Quality (Karman Space & Defense). 
 
**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** 

* Lead, develop, and manage the Quality Engineering team supporting all Defense programs and projects.
* Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, proactive risk management, and continuous improvement across Defense Quality functions.
* Serve as the primary Defense quality leader to the VP of Defense and the Defense leadership team.
* Ensure the quality of all Defense hardware, assemblies, engineered systems, and services produced across multiple sites.
* Oversee program quality planning, including inspection strategies, qualification/verification plans, critical characteristics control, product safety considerations, and risk mitigation.
* Review and approve quality requirements for Defense proposals, contracts, and manufacturing plans.
* Drive effective root cause analysis, corrective action, and failure review processes for Defense programs.
* Ensure each Defense site maintains compliance to AS9100, customer requirements, and regulatory obligations.
* Provide direct guidance to site Quality Managers/Quality Engineers on QMS implementation, audit readiness, and procedural improvement.
* Support site internal audits, customer audits, DCMA oversight, and third‑party certification audits.
* Partner with the Enterprise Director of Quality to align Defense site QMS structures, documentation, and practices with the enterprise quality framework.
* Support the long-term strategy to transition multiple Defense AS9100 certificates into a unified enterprise certificate.
* Collaborate closely on enterprise initiatives such as configuration management improvements, risk management systems, document control harmonization, supplier quality strategies, and enterprise metrics.

 
**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE** 

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, or related technical field preferred
* 10 years of experience in aerospace/defense quality roles preferred.
* Strong working knowledge of AS9100, ISO 9001, and Defense customer quality standards.
* Quality Engineering experience with complex programs including design.

**TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS**

Occasional travel 0-10% of the time.
