Futures start here. Where first steps, new friendships, and confident learners are born. At KinderCare Learning Companies, the first and only early childhood education provider recognized with the**Gallup Exceptional Workplace Award**, we offer a variety of early education and child care options for families. Whether it’s KinderCare Learning Centers, Champions, or Crème de la Crème, we build confidence for kids, families, and the future we share. And we want you to join us in shaping it—in neighborhoods, at work, and in schools nationwide.

At Crème de la Crème, learning comes alive like nowhere else. Our centers are places that never stand still because kids never do. And when you join us, you’ll become part of that magic—making a memorable impact on young learners and their families every day. In our wow-worthy world of learning, your talents will be the catalyst for creating child care experiences you've never imagined. You’ll link arms with other exceptional humans who care as much about helping kids reach their highest potential as you do—and you’ll know that your work matters.

* As the Crème School Director of Education and Quality, you will 
 + Lead and develop teachers to ensure curriculum alignment with best practices, state standards, and the individual needs of children.
 + Facilitate training and implementation of our comprehensive and developmentally appropriate curriculum for early childhood education.
 + Provide transformative leadership in the field of early childhood education, staying informed about current trends, research, and best practices.
 + Develop a culture of continuous learning and professional development while leading the teaching staff.
 + Establish and maintain high-quality standards for early childhood education program
 + Conduct regular assessments, evaluations, and audits to ensure compliance with Crème standards and licensing requirements
 + Provide guidance and support to teaching staff, promoting a positive and collaborative work environment. In partnership with the Executive Director, host professional development programs to enhance educators' skills and knowledge.
 + Cultivate positive relationships with teachers and parents, involving them in their child's education and development.
 + Collaborate with the community to enhance the educational experience and promote your school within the community.
 + Assist as needed in daily school operations, at times including direct supervision of children
 + Apply data-driven insights to assess program effectiveness, implement strategies to address identified areas of improvement, fostering a culture of continuous quality enhancement.
* Qualifications:
* + Bachelor’s degree in early childhood education, Education Administration, or a related field. (preferred)
 + Meet state specific credentials / guidelines for the role
 + At least one year leadership experience in early childhood education or a related field
 + Proven understanding of early childhood development, educational best practices, and program administration.
 + Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
 + Outstanding customer service skills, strong organizational skills, and multi-task and handle multiple situations optimally.
 + Proven ability to build and sustain positive relationships with diverse staff, families, and community. Commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion in education.
 + Physically able to use a computer with basic proficiency, lift a minimum of 40pounds, and work indoors or outdoors.
 + Able to assume postures in low levels to allow physical and visual contact with children, see and hear well enough to keep children safe, and engage in physical activity.
 + Read, write, understand, and speak English to connect with children and their parents in English.

**Location** Frederick, Maryland, United States **Job ID** R-264437 **Date posted** 15/11/2026

 

**Director Biochemical & Biophysical Methods**

**Reports to:** Senior Director, Global Technical Operations – Manufacturing Process and Analytical Science – Analytical

**Location:** Frederick, MD USA

Located on the Frederick, MD Manufacturing Campus, GTO operates a state-of-the-art laboratory equipped with modern analytical instrumentation and small-scale drug substance process capabilities—a truly one-of-a-kind asset within AZ Bio Ops. As Director of Biochemical & Biophysical Methods, you will lead a substantial part of this operation, managing a high-performing team of scientists who serve as subject matter experts (SMEs) for the biochemical and biophysical methods used to release and characterize our late-stage and commercial products. The team's core responsibilities include method validation and transfer, method lifecycle management, manufacturing investigation support, critical reagent qualification, and analytical testing in support of process improvement projects. You will also play a key strategic role in transforming analytical testing within AZ Bio by implementing innovative technologies, leveraging automation to replace manual workflows, and integrating advanced analytical technologies into upstream and downstream manufacturing processes. This is a leadership role where you will partner with peers across internal and external QC testing sites, other GTO functions, R&D, Quality, Regulatory, and Supply Chain organizations to ensure a continuous supply of medicines to patients.

**Typical Accountabilities:**
-----------------------------

* Lead a team that is responsible for execution of all biochemical and biophysical methods including capillary electrophoresis/focusing, HPLC, UPLC, mass spectrometry, circular dichroism, differential scanning calorimetry, and various spectroscopic techniques. Execution of this suite of assays typically support method validation, analytical tech transfer, critical reagent qualification, and process improvement projects.

* Plays a key role in identifying and implementing improvement projects within the lab function including integration of automation/liquid handling into workflows, use of generative AI for report generation, data compilation, and review. Works cross-functionally with peers across the organization to help define next generation analytical strategy across the company.

* Maintain GTO’s lab space in a state of GMP compliance.

* Be able to troubleshoot biochemical and biophysical methods.

* **To succeed in this role, you will need to be self-motivated, innovative, have strong technical and communication skills, and a deep understanding of protein chemistry and relevant methods used to release biological products.**

* **Mentors and develops staff of approximately eight direct reports; this is a people manager role.**

**Education, Qualifications, Skills, and Experience**
-----------------------------------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree technical field such as Pharmacy, Biology, Chemistry.

* Preferred advanced degree (MS or PhD) in a scientific field

* Subject matter expert in multiple biochemical and biophysical methods including HPLC, UPLC, capillary electrophoresis/focusing, mass spectrometry, circular dichroism, and differential scanning calorimetry.

* Minimum 10 years of experience working in the pharmaceutical industry.

* Working experience in supervisory / managerial roles within quality in the Pharmaceutical Industry.

* Experience working with regulatory / SOP / GxP requirements and driving compliance.

* Leading complex projects / operations in terms of resources, vendors, and budgets.

* Driving substantial change initiatives through internal/external teams and partners

The annual base salary for this position ranges from $174,856-$262,285 USD However, base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market locat

The Market Director, Facility Operations provides strategic and operational leadership for facility operations across the East Pierce Market within MultiCare Health System, including hospitals, ambulatory sites, urgent care centers, clinics, medical office buildings, and other healthcare facilities. 
 
This role is accountable for market-level facility operations, plant operations, building systems, property management, regulatory compliance, infrastructure reliability, and facility-related operational planning.
 
 
The Market Director serves as the primary operational partner between East Pierce Market leadership and system Facilities Management & Operations Support Services (FMOSS), Planning, Design & Construction, Real Estate, and other enterprise support teams.

**Company Summary:**

We are a fast-growing, innovative company that is revolutionizing global health. At Vireo and pH-D you will be on the ground-floor of an exciting fast-growing company that focuses on its core values and is passionate about improving the lives of people and pets by delivering premium, health products through world-class research innovation and manufacturing.

**Position Summary:**

The Plant Manager has full operational accountability for the chemical manufacturing facility at Vireo Resources in Plattsmouth, Nebraska. This leader owns facility performance from raw material readiness through batch execution, finished product handoff, and shipment readiness. The role delivers safe, consistent, efficient, and cost-effective batches that meet approved specifications and production commitments, with direct accountability for people, production, manufacturing cost, equipment reliability, and continuous improvement.

**Role and Responsibilities:**

* **Operational Leadership:** Lead facility operations across all shifts, aligning production schedules, staffing, materials, and equipment availability to meet demand. Manage budgets and drive improvements in productivity, cost, quality, and delivery.
* **Process and Technical Leadership:** Apply chemistry and engineering expertise to improve manufacturing processes and resolve recurring issues. Partner with cross-functional teams to lead startups, establish operating standards, and ensure consistent execution of approved procedures.
* **Safety, Quality, and Compliance:** Ensure operations meet safety, environmental, and quality requirements. Oversee chemical handling, process safety, and emergency readiness, and lead corrective actions with EHS and Quality while preserving Quality’s independent product release authority.
* **People Leadership:** Hire, coach, and develop facility teams, ensuring effective shift coverage and employee competency. Establish clear expectations and reinforce accountability, collaboration, and Vireo’s core values.
* **Strategic Planning and Performance:** Develop capacity and improvement plans that support company growth. Execute approved capital projects and communicate operational results, financial performance, risks, and recovery plans to leadership.

**Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree or above in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Process Engineering, or a related field.
* 8+ years in chemical manufacturing, including 3+ years leading plant operations. Experience must include people, production, and budget accountability.
* Proven batch manufacturing leadership with measurable improvements in yield, cycle time, quality, output, and cost.
* Strong budgeting, cost analysis, capacity planning, and KPI management skills.
* Strong knowledge of chemical processes, reaction engineering, utilities, and automated controls. Translate technical issues into practical decisions and communicate clearly.
* Ability to lead a 24/7 operation and respond to urgent operating issues.
* Proven ability to develop teams, set expectations, and hold employees accountable.
* Strong troubleshooting and root cause analysis skills. Demonstrated success preventing recurring failures.
* Knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma, or similar improvement methods. Certification preferred.
* Commitment to safety, environmental stewardship, quality, and compliance. Plant startup, commissioning, or expansion experience preferred.
* Travel up to 10%

**Physical Demands / Work Environment:**

* Ability to stand, walk, climb stairs, and perform essential plant duties, with or without reasonable accommodation up to 10 hours.
* Must be able to occasionally lift up to 50 pounds
* Ability to work around chemicals, heat, noise, and equipment using required safeguards and PPE.
* Availability for extended hours or weekends during startup, outages, emergencies, and critical operations.

**Compensation + Benefits:**

* Base salary + bonus based on company and personal performance
* Medical, Denta

Sr. Manager, Quality SME (BESS)

Hanwha Qcells USA Corp (“HQC US”) develops, invests, and delivers solar photovoltaic (PV) and battery energy storage systems (BESS) projects through Engineering, Procurement, Construction (EPC) services in North America.

The company brings a decade of global leadership in solar PV to deliver utility-scale power generation plants customized for local and regional energy markets. HQC US offers the full spectrum of PV solutions – from the core technology of cells and modules to large-scale project development and investment. With proven capabilities across the solar and battery storage chain, HQC US minimizes uncertainty and risk, and helps customers achieve a higher return on their investment in renewable energy.

SUMMARY

The Sr. Manager, Quality SME (BESS) (“Quality SME”) serves as the company’s subject matter expert and technical authority for Quality on Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) construction. The Quality SME is responsible for developing and maintaining the processes, systems, Inspection & Test Plan (ITP) templates, Quality Control Verification Checklists, and Standard Work Instructions (SWIs) that govern how Quality is planned, executed, and documented on BESS scopes, whether self-performed or subcontracted. The role covers both standalone BESS facilities and BESS integrated with utility-scale solar PV projects.

The Quality SME works alongside the Regional Quality Managers on every project with active BESS construction, integrating discipline requirements into the project Quality program and providing technical direction to the Quality Field Leads and Quality Inspectors hired for these scopes. Those personnel report to the assigned Site Quality Manager or Sr. Site Quality Manager, who remains the single point of contact and the ranking Quality authority on site. The Quality SME holds a matrixed line of technical direction to the discipline team, participates in hiring, onboarding, training, and performance input, and is accountable for the technical consistency, process discipline, and record integrity of BESS Quality across the portfolio.

Success in this role requires deep practical knowledge of utility-scale BESS construction, including equipment foundations and anchorage, battery enclosures and containers, power conversion systems (PCS) and inverters, medium-voltage transformers, auxiliary power, DC and AC cabling and terminations, grounding and bonding, thermal management systems, and fire detection, suppression, gas detection, and explosion control installation interfaces. Equally important is a working command of manufacturer-specific installation, preservation, and warranty requirements, which often govern acceptance more directly than the project drawings. The Quality SME aligns closely with the Engineering and BESS teams to integrate Quality early and resolve technical questions consistently. Design interpretation, battery management and energy management system configuration, functional commissioning, and capacity testing remain with Engineering, Commissioning, and the manufacturer; the Quality SME ensures those interfaces are defined, documented, and respected.

This position reports directly to the Senior Director of Quality (or another designated member of senior management). The role is remote, with standard business hours of Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. local time, or as site construction hours dictate during jobsite visits. Travel is required up to 50% of the time, which includes scheduled jobsite visits for oversight and technical authority, as well as short-notice trips and extended site visits as business needs dictate.

Shield AI is actively seeking candidates with deep expertise in manufacturing and quality methodologies, paired with a relentless drive to enable supplier success and strengthen mission-critical operations.

Shield AI’s Supply Chain Quality team is responsible for global quality oversight across our supplier base. The team reduces supply-chain risk through supplier assessments and internal risk reviews, proactively drives supplier qualification and development activities.

* Develop the supplier quality team responsible for supplier qualification, surveillance, performance management, and corrective-action activities across Shield AI’s global aerospace and defense supply base.

* Oversee supplier qualification, risk assessments, periodic performance reviews, supplier audits, source inspections, and approved-supplier status across complex aerospace hardware, commodities, and manufacturing processes.
* Ensure supplier requirements are effectively flowed down and that suppliers comply with applicable quality management system, engineering, customer, contractual, regulatory, and statutory requirements.
* Escalate significant supplier-quality risks and direct SCARs, supplier recovery efforts, and capability-improvement plans that could affect product quality, delivery, mission readiness, or program execution.
* Partner with Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, Supply Chain, and Program teams to address supplier producibility, design-for-manufacturability, process capability, technical execution, and quality risks.
* Advance supplier-quality processes, business systems, data analytics, and continuous-improvement practices that strengthen supplier capability, product quality, delivery performance, and supply-base resilience.

**Required qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, or another related technical discipline.
* At least 7 years of relevant experience, including 2–5 years of leadership or people-management experience with direct responsibility for Quality Engineering and/or Supplier Quality

record.ROLE_TEXT:
Livingston Associates has partnered with an established company, made up of highly skilled, capable individuals who are looking to add a Director of Operations to their growing team! 
 
**Position Summary:** 
The Director of Operations is responsible for overseeing the day-to-day operations for a specialty contractor with multiple offices in NYS, ensuring projects are executed safely, efficiently, and profitably. This role partners closely with the CEO/Owner to translate strategic goals into executable plans across field operations, labor, scheduling, safety, compliance, and internal processes.. This position should be filled with a proven hands-on leader who can operate independently, make sound business decisions, manage multiple operational priorities, and contribute strategically to the company's overall success. 
 
**Compensation:**

* **$**130,000-$160,000 per year

 
**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Operations & Field Execution**:
 + Oversee daily operations across all projects, ensuring schedules, budgets, and quality standards are met
 + Coordinate closely with Field Operations, Safety & Compliance and project managers to support successful project delivery
 + Resolve operational issues impacting productivity, customer satisfaction, or safety
 + Ensure materials, labor, equipment are properly aligned with project needs
* **Financial & Performance Management**
 + Support job cost controls, labor efficiency, and margin performance
 + Monitor KPIs related to productivity, safety, schedule adherence, and profitability
 + Collaborate with accounting and project teams on forecasting, labor planning, and cash flow management
* **Labor & Workforce Management**
 + Partner with field operations for workforce planning, labor projections, and staffing levels
 + Support hiring, onboarding, training, and development of field and operations staff
 + Foster a culture of accountability, teamwork, and high performance
* **Safety, Compliance & Risk Management**
 + Partner with safety & compliance team to ensure compliance with OSHA, regulatory requirements, and company safety programs
 + Promote a strong safety-first culture across all field and office operations
 + Identify and mitigate operational and contractual risks
* **Process Improvement & Systems**
 + Develop, implement, and refine operational processes to improve efficiency and scalability
 + Lead adoption of tools, technology, and systems that streamline operations and reporting
 + Standardize best practices across projects and teams
* **Leadership & Strategy**
 + Partner with the CEO on strategic planning, growth initiatives, and operational alignment
 + Provide leadership, mentorship, and direction to operations team members
 + Support customer relationships and assist with issue resolution as needed

 
**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field preferred. Equivalent industry experience will be considered.
* Minimum of 10–15 years of progressive experience in commercial construction or specialty contracting.
* Minimum of 5–7 years in a senior operational leadership position with direct responsibility for project execution, personnel management, and financial performance.
* Demonstrated success managing operations for a construction company or division generating $20M–$40M+ in annual revenue.
* Experience overseeing multiple project teams and simultaneous projects across various geographic markets.

 
**Benefits & Incentives:**

* Paid time off
* Sick time
* 6 paid company holidays
* Health, Dental & Vision plan options
* Car allowance
* Fuel card
* 401(k) plan
* Professional development
* Short- & Long-term disability
* Life insurance
* Company/Team events
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

**The Director of Operations/Master Orchestrator** we want on our Pro Roofers Dream Team is someone who thrives on turning all the moving parts into a well-oiled machine! You are a natural leader who sees the big picture without ever losing sight of the details. Where others see obstacles, you see solutions. Where others see disorganization, you see an opportunity to build a better system.

You get a genuine sense of satisfaction from watching a team operate at its best because you've put the right people, processes, and expectations in place. You love numbers because they tell a story, and you know how to use that story to make things better. You're not afraid to roll up your sleeves, tackle a problem head-on, or have the tough conversations that keep everyone moving forward.

You're organized without being rigid and driven without losing your good nature. You know how to bring out the best in people while holding them accountable for results. You're a builder of systems, a solver of problems, and a master of follow-through. Most importantly, you take genuine pride in creating an operation that runs smoothly, profitably, and with excellence.

Job Duties/Responsibilities

* Be the driving force behind the day-to-day operations of Pro Roofers, ensuring everything runs efficiently from signed contract to completed project and final payment.
* Lead, support, and hold production teams accountable for completing jobs on time, within budget, and to our high standards of quality.
* Masterfully coordinate scheduling, material ordering, production, quality control, and billing to keep every job moving forward.
* Develop and maintain quality control processes that ensure exceptional workmanship and customer satisfaction.
* Keep a watchful eye on the production pipeline, anticipating problems and removing bottlenecks before they become costly.
* Track job costs, profit margins, and operational performance. You know your numbers and use them to make smart decisions!
* Create and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) that keep the team focused on measurable results.
* Keep our CRM accurate, organized, and functioning as a valuable management tool.
* Lead productive team meetings and individual check-ins that create clarity, accountability, and momentum.
* Build, document, and continually improve systems that make our operations more efficient and scalable.
* Embrace technology, software, and AI tools to simplify processes and help our team work smarter.
* Partner with our sales leadership to ensure a seamless transition from the sale to successful project completion.
* Cultivate a team environment built on trust, excellence, personal responsibility, and a shared commitment to success.

Qualifications

* Proven experience managing operations in the roofing or solar industry.
* A natural ability to lead people, build strong relationships, and inspire accountability.
* Exceptional organizational skills with an almost instinctive ability to identify what needs attention.
* A strong understanding of job costing, profit margins, budgets, and operational performance metrics.
* A numbers-driven mindset. You appreciate accurate data and know how to turn it into actionable improvements.
* Experience implementing and improving operational systems and procedures.
* Confidence working with CRM systems and business management software.
* An appreciation for emerging technology, including AI, and its ability to improve business efficiency.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to navigate challenging conversations with professionalism.
* A commitment to quality, consistency, and doing things right the first time.
* A proactive, solution-oriented attitude. You don't wait for someone else to fix a problem. You take ownership and get it done!
* Willingness to work long hours during the busy season.
* Agility to climb on a roof and walk the ridge.

Job Details

Location: Kansas City Area (On-site and in the field

**Fresh & Ready Foods** is seeking a strategic and hands-on **Operations Director** to lead our Longview, TX manufacturing facility. As the site leader, this role is responsible for overseeing all aspects of production, food safety, quality, maintenance, warehousing, and distribution while driving operational excellence and developing high-performing teams.

Reporting to the Regional Director, the Operations Director will be accountable for achieving safety, quality, service, inventory, and financial objectives while fostering a culture of continuous improvement and employee engagement. This highly visible leadership role requires a strong manufacturing background, a passion for people development, and the ability to drive results in a fast-paced food production environment.

####

* Champion safety, regulatory compliance, and food safety programs, including SQF, HACCP, sanitation, and audit readiness.
* Drive Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement initiatives to improve productivity, reduce waste, and optimize plant performance.
* Establish and manage KPIs related to safety, quality, labor, yield, inventory, customer service, and on-time delivery.
* Partner with cross-functional teams to support customer growth, new product introductions, and operational initiatives.
* Manage budgets, labor costs, inventory levels, and operational expenses to achieve financial objectives.
* Maintain a visible presence on the production floor, coaching leaders and supporting problem-solving efforts.
* Build succession plans and develop future leaders within the organization.
* Foster a culture focused on operational excellence, customer satisfaction, and continuous improvement.

#### 

#### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Operations, Engineering, Business, Food Science, Supply Chain, or related field preferred.
* 7+ years of progressive leadership experience in food manufacturing, beverage manufacturing, CPG, protein processing, bakery, prepared foods, or related manufacturing environments.
* Experience managing large production teams through multiple levels of leadership.
* Strong knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Continuous Improvement, Six Sigma, TPS, or similar methodologies.
* Proven track record improving safety, quality, productivity, and financial performance.
* Experience with SQF, HACCP, FDA/USDA regulations, sanitation programs, and quality systems.
* Strong financial acumen, including budgeting, labor management, inventory control, and operational reporting.
* Excellent communication, coaching, and leadership skills.

Coordinated Services Management (CSM) is an established senior living management company serving nonprofit and mission-driven organizations throughout Virginia. We are seeking an experienced Regional Director of Operations to provide leadership, guidance, and operational oversight for assigned skilled nursing, assisted living and memory care communities in Virginia. This position is based in Roanoke and requires regular travel to assigned communities.

The ideal candidate is a collaborative, results-oriented leader with strong operational and financial management skills, sound clinical knowledge, and a commitment to quality resident care and services.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide leadership, coaching, and operational oversight to community Executive Directors and leadership teams.
* Drive operational excellence, regulatory compliance, quality of care, resident satisfaction, and financial performance.
* Monitor occupancy, marketing effectiveness, staffing, budgets, and financial results, identifying opportunities for improvement and growth.
* Partner with community leadership and home office team to address operational challenges and implement effective solutions.
* Support leadership development, performance management, and succession planning.
* Guide strategic planning, capital improvements, and effective stewardship of community resources.
* Collaborate with nonprofit ownership Boards, presenting operational results, financial performance, budgets, and strategic recommendations.
* Support the mission, values, and long-term success of each community and its nonprofit ownership.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in healthcare administration, nursing, or a related field.
* Licensed Nursing Home Administrator with a minimum of three years of Executive Director experience.
* Strong understanding of senior living operations, regulatory compliance, and resident care practices; clinical experience is highly desirable.
* Demonstrated success in leadership development, financial management, and operational improvement.
* Excellent communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Multi-community leadership experience and experience with nonprofit organizations preferred.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.
* Ability to travel throughout Virginia, including occasional overnight travel.

**Compensation**

Competitive salary commensurate with experience and qualifications.

**Join CSM and make a meaningful difference in the lives of seniors while supporting the success of mission-driven communities.**

Coordinated Services Management is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

* Professional development assistance

Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai https://shield.ai/. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/shield-ai, X https://x.com/shieldaitech, Instagram https://www.instagram.com/shield_ai, and YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@Shield_AI. 

 

Job Description:

The Senior Air Vehicle Operator (AVO) – Deployment Operations is responsible for executing and leading V-BAT flight operations in support of DoD and foreign customers in both land-based and maritime OCONUS environments. This is an operationally focused role requiring strong aviation judgment, disciplined execution, and the ability to lead small teams in austere and high-visibility conditions. 

 

The Senior AVO is responsible for leading mission planning activities, performing comprehensive risk assessments, delivering pre-mission briefings, executing flight operations, and conducting structured post-flight debriefs. This role includes conducting Functional Check Flights (FCFs) and system validation as required, ensuring aircraft configuration control and logbook accuracy, coordinating with maintenance to sustain fleet readiness, and supporting overall operational discipline. The Senior AVO will mentor junior operators, serve as the on-site operational representative to customers, and travel extensively in support of deployments. 

 

This is not an entry-level flight operations role. The ideal candidate brings strong aviation fundamentals, disciplined cockpit habits, and mature operational decision-making. They must be comfortable leading deployments, briefing customers, managing risk in dynamic environments, and maintaining professionalism in high-visibility settings. The Senior AVO must balance mission execution with customer satisfaction while upholding the highest standards of safety, compliance, and operational excellence. 

Required Qualifications:

 - Minimum of 2000 documented unmanned flight hours or 1000 manned flight hours 

 - Demonstrated instructor experience (manned or unmanned aviation)  

 - FAA Private Pilot License (PPL)  

 - FAA Part 107 Remote Pilot Certificate 

 - Ability to obtain and maintain an FAA Class II Medical Certificate 

 - Ability to obtain and hold a Secret DoD security clearance 

 - Ability to pass background, drug screening, and customer-required medical/dental screenings 

 - Willingness to travel up to 50–75% in support of deployments 

 - Ability to lead and operate independently in small teams under austere conditions 

 - Strong aviation judgment, decision-making, and risk management skills 

Preferred Qualifications

 - FAA Instrument Rating and/or Commercial Pilot License  

 - Experience operating as aircrew on manned aircraft  

 - Prior military service, particularly with overseas or deployed operations  

 - Maritime or shipboard UAS operational experience  

 - Previous experience as a Site Lead or in a leadership role overseeing aviation operations

As a core member of the Strategy & Operations team, you’ll apply structured problem‑solving, financial rigor, and operational discipline to turn strategic priorities into actionable, measurable outcomes. Skydweller Aero Inc. has its global and US headquarters in Oklahoma City, with European operations headquartered in Spain.

Role Summary

 

As Skydweller prepares to move from development toward aircraft production, we are looking for an experienced manufacturing executive to build and lead our production organization. This role is based in **Oklahoma City, OK** and reports to the Chief Operating Officer.

The Vice President, Manufacturing & Production will own all aircraft production operations: final assembly, systems integration, avionics installation, production testing, factory operations and aircraft delivery. You will lead the organization as we scale from prototype and low-rate initial production into sustained manufacturing.

We are looking for a hands-on aerospace manufacturing leader with a proven track record of building production organizations, improving factory performance and delivering complex aircraft in FAA-regulated environments.

**Why join:** Most manufacturing leadership roles optimize an existing production system. This one builds it. You will establish the manufacturing organization, develop the factory workforce, and scale production of one of the most ambitious autonomous aircraft programs in aerospace.

**Production leadership**

 

* Lead all aircraft production and manufacturing operations.
* Drive safe, efficient and repeatable aircraft production.
* Build and lead a high-performing manufacturing organization, with clear management systems, metrics and operating rhythms.
* Foster a culture of accountability, safety, quality and continuous improvement.

 

**Assembly and integration**

* Oversee final assembly, systems and electrical integration, avionics installation and aircraft completion.
* Ensure aircraft are built to engineering, quality and regulatory requirements.
* Drive production readiness and resolve manufacturing constraints and bottlenecks.

 

**Production planning and execution**

* Own execution of the Master Production Schedule.
* Lead production planning, labor allocation and resource management.
* Set capacity plans that support production-rate growth.
* Monitor factory performance and drive throughput, productivity and efficiency improvements.

 

**Production testing and acceptance**

* Lead production acceptance testing and ground test operations.
* Coordinate production readiness with Engineering, Quality, Flight Operations and Program Management.
* Ensure aircraft move smoothly from production through acceptance and delivery.

 

**Regulatory compliance and quality**

* Ensure compliance with FAA Part 21 production requirements and the company quality management system.
* Maintain production configuration control and manufacturing documentation discipline.
* Support internal, regulatory and customer audits and certification activities.
* Partner with Quality leadership to improve first-pass yield.

* Develop the manufacturing infrastructure, facilities and staffing plans needed for higher production rates.
* Implement lean manufacturing and operational excellence initiatives.

* Establish workforce development and skills-training programs.
* Build strong partnerships across Engineering, Supply Chain, Quality, Flight Operations and Program Management.

* Must have experience leading cross-functional teams and coordinating technical, manufacturing, and production activities.
* Must have experience managing program budgets, financial performance, forecasting, and resource allocation.
* Must have experience executing government contracts, including FAR-based contracts, OTAs, and task orders.

record.ROLE_TEXT:
Plant Manager

**Piedmont, South Carolina | Industrial Adhesives**

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced and dynamic **Plant Manager** to lead our manufacturing operation in **Piedmont, South Carolina**. This is a highly visible leadership role for a proven manufacturing leader who can **drive change, develop high-performing teams, strengthen accountability, and deliver operational excellence**.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on, people-focused leader who can set a clear vision, engage employees at all levels, challenge the status quo, and build a culture centered on **safety, quality, continuous improvement, collaboration, and results**.

Key Responsibilities

* Provide overall leadership and direction for plant operations, including **Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost, People, and Continuous Improvement**.
* Lead **organizational and cultural change**, building employee engagement, accountability, and ownership.
* Develop, coach, and strengthen the plant leadership team while building the organization's future talent pipeline.
* Champion a zero-incident safety culture and ensure compliance with EHS requirements.
* Drive operational excellence using **Lean Six Sigma, OEE, VSM, root-cause analysis, and continuous improvement tools**.
* Deliver plant financial, productivity, quality, customer service, and inventory objectives.
* Partner across Operations, Supply Chain, Engineering, Quality, R&D, Sales, and other business functions to achieve business goals.
* Identify and eliminate barriers, improve processes, and create sustainable improvements in plant performance.
* Maintain a strong presence on the manufacturing floor and actively engage with supervisors and employees.
* Lead and support capital investments and improvement initiatives aligned with business strategy.

What We're Looking For

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, or a related technical discipline.
* 10+ years of progressive manufacturing, engineering, or operations experience.
* Proven manufacturing leadership experience with a strong record of **leading change and improving performance**.
* Demonstrated ability to **build, coach, and lead high-performing teams**.
* Strong business acumen with the ability to drive accountability and results.
* Experience with Lean Six Sigma and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Excellent communication, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Chemical, specialty chemical, adhesives, batch/process manufacturing, or similar experience preferred.

The Leader We're Looking For

You are a **visible, decisive, and engaging leader** who knows how to bring people along through change. You set clear expectations, hold yourself and others accountable, develop talent, and create an environment where employees are empowered to solve problems and improve the business.

Most importantly, you can **deliver today's results while transforming the organization for tomorrow**.

Job Summary - Why you’ll love this position

Are you motivated by the challenge of solving complex, enterprise-wide problems? Do you love asking "why" and transforming good operations into exceptional public experiences? If so, consider joining the State of Missouri as our next Director of Operational Excellence!

In this pivotal leadership role you will champion continuous improvement across state government, lead our operational initiatives, and oversee our statewide customer experience program. This position resides within the Office of Administration, the administrative arm of the executive branch, but leads efforts that span all executive agencies to improve service delivery to the citizens of Missouri.

We are seeking an energetic, visionary executive to lead and empower a dedicated team of process improvement and customer experience efforts while serving as a strategic partner to executive leadership, agency partners, and frontline public servants. Our next director is a bridge-builder who combines proven improvement methodologies with human-centered design, modern customer experience principles, rapid responsiveness to agency partner needs, and a passion for coaching state team members to achieve measurable public outcomes.

In addition to the inspiring work that will improve the services provided by state government and your colleagues work environment, you will receive a great benefits package that includes paid time off, medical/vision/dental insurance, life insurance, and retirement.

*The salary indicated represents a base pay rate. If the individual selected or the position is eligible for a pay differential (e.g., shift, security, or years of service), it will be added to the total compensation in your paycheck. A pay differential does not raise your base pay.*

Responsibilities - What you’ll do

* Work collaboratively with leadership and teams to encourage, develop, and execute strategies to create a culture of continuous improvement across Missouri state government. Measure the effectiveness of improvements and provide administration with visibility to such improvements.
* Act as a subject matter expert and promote change management by sharing Lean Six Sigma and other Operational Excellence best practices. Teach, mentor, coach and lead Operational Excellence leaders from every state department.
* Continuously provide helpful operational excellence resources for team members and facilitate training sessions.
* Model excellence in leadership and act with urgency to achieve results and lead efforts to cultivate a culture of data-based decision making.
* Facilitate, lead, and oversee state level strategic initiatives and other projects as assigned by leadership.
* Coordinate and host an annual Show Me Excellence Summit and represent the State of Missouri at national operational excellence events.

Qualifications - All you need for success

**Minimum Qualifications**

* A bachelor’s degree or equivalent
* Formal training in Lean Six Sigma or an equivalent continuous process improvement framework. Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification is strongly preferred
* Demonstrated advanced knowledge in Lean and Operational Excellence frameworks and facilitation methodologies
* Hands-on experience work with survey, feedback, or data visualization platforms, such as Qualtrics, Tableau, or Power BI

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Must be action oriented, demonstrate superior organizational abilities and have strong facilitation skills and excellent communications skills.
* Ability to work with leaders and multi-level teams to establish goals, performance indicators, actions plans and deliverables and effectively communicating across broad audiences.
* Must have excellent leadership abilities. This individual must be an effective collaborator with energy, enthusiasm and a can-do attitude who can empower others, gain buy-in and achieve results.
* Good understanding of data analysis related to process improvement a

record.ROLE_TEXT:
**Job Overview**

Flexim Group is seeking an experienced Global Account Operations Manager to provide senior operational leadership for a strategic international account operating across complex sites and manufacturing environments.

Based in Jersey City, you will hold global accountability for operational performance across the account, leading regional and site teams to deliver consistent FM and technical services, safety, compliance and business continuity.

This is a management operations role requiring strong experience, technical credibility and the ability to lead through senior regional and site operations teams. You will set operational standards, challenge performance, manage critical escalations and translate global client priorities into disciplined execution across countries and facilities.

**Duties**

* Lead global operational performance across a complex, multi-country manufacturing account.
* Lead and challenge regional and site Operations Managers, ensuring clear accountability and consistent execution.
* Drive services excellence, with a strong focus on asset reliability, maintenance, utilities and critical infrastructure.
* Establish and enforce global operational standards, while ensuring effective implementation at regional and site level.
* Monitor and challenge operational performance through KPIs, SLAs, CMMS/BMS data, maintenance completion, backlog and asset uptime.
* Lead critical operational escalations.
* Drive continuous improvement and operational excellence, identifying opportunities to improve reliability, efficiency, service quality and cost performance.
* Lead global account financial performance, including budgeting, forecasting, cost control and profitability.
* Partner with senior client stakeholders, translating strategic objectives into operational priorities and measurable results.
* Act as the senior operational authority for the account, providing executive-level governance, reporting and decision-making.

**Experience**

* Substantial operational leadership experience in Integrated Facilities Management, ideally across a multi-country portfolio.
* Strong working knowledge of hard FM and building engineering services
* Demonstrated experience controlling SLAs, KPIs, CMMS workflows, asset registers, maintenance backlogs and technical compliance.
* Proven ownership of account P&L, budgeting, forecasting, subcontractor costs and commercial change control.
* Experience leading dispersed operational teams and managing specialist service providers across different regulatory environments.
* Confident client-facing leadership, supported by operational discipline, sound judgement and a willingness to be present on site.
* Significant leadership experience within Integrated Facilities Management.
* Proven success managing complex global or multi-country client accounts.
* Strong executive stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.
* Strong understanding of operational excellence, governance and performance management.
* Excellent communication, negotiation and influencing skills.
* A proactive, accountable and client-centric leadership style.

Pay: $135,000.00 - $150,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Professional development assistance
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Jersey City, NJ 07307

**About Us** 
Ten Five Hospitality is a growing collective of restaurants, bars, and entertainment venues known for concept-driven experiences and standout hospitality. Headquartered between Los Angeles and Miami, Ten Five holds a history of working with and crafting some of the most sought after brands in the world. Ten Five represents the organizational, operational and creative excellence to bring original and authentic visions to life while outperforming the market on the bottom-line.

**Position Summary**

The Director of Operations – Restaurants is responsible for overseeing effective operating procedures within the restaurant while developing a successful management team.

**Daily Responsibilities**

* Plan and direct administration and planning functions of the Food & Beverage department to meet the daily needs of the operation.

* Possesses in-depth knowledge of all operational systems in use including but not limited to payroll, inventory and purchasing.
* Ensures that all mechanical systems are in good working order and compliant with all federal, state and local ordinances.
* Regulates all executive-level POS functions.
* Oversee and supervise the execution of front-of-house operations to ensure quality, safety, efficiency, and profitability.
* Assists managers in establishing and achieving predetermined profit objectives and desired standards of quality of food, service, cleanliness and promotion.
* Responsible, with the Executive Chef and General Manager, for maintaining the venue’s monthly Profit & Loss statement standards while meeting or exceeding budget expectations through controlling P&L items.

* Oversees that the venue is compliant with all federal, state, and local laws and regulations and company policies.

* Oversees that all guest and employee concerns are resolved in a way that promotes guest retention.
* Oversees the replacement or repair of all breakage or damage of equipment, furniture, or other company property.
* Ensures front-of-house employees follow all policies and procedures by providing clear guidelines and expectations.
* Maintain professional appearance standards as directed in the Employee Handbook.
* Anticipates and accommodates needs of guests while providing professional and exceptional service to ensure guest satisfaction.
* Protects establishment, guests, and employees by adhering to and overseeing that the Department of Health and company sanitation standards are followed.
* Responsible for management interviewing, hiring, and training process decisions.
* Coaches front-of-house managers as needed and assists in their professional development.

**Physical Requirements**

* Must be able to stand, walk, lift, and bend for extended periods of time.
* Must be able to bend and lift up to 50 lbs.
* Role may include job duties or tasks requiring repetitive motions.
* Exposure to hot kitchen elements or cleaning materials.

* Minimum five (5) years’ experience working in a general management role in hospitality/nightlife/ bars.
* Passionate about hospitality, food and beverage and morale/culture.
* Ability to think proactively and creatively, have decision making and analytical skills and be effective in written and verbal communication.
* Self-motivated with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, effectively multi-task, and drive results.
* Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills.
* Ability to work a flexible schedule including evenings, weekends, and holidays when required.

Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. Leveraging its differentiated RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor platform, the company is advancing a broad, integrated portfolio of oral RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to directly target the active, cancer-driving state of RAS. Founded on rigorous scientific inquiry and a willingness to challenge long-held assumptions, Revolution Medicines is committed to changing the trajectory of disease for patients with RAS-addicted cancers worldwide.

Our people are united by a shared way of working: follow the science, challenge assumptions, act with urgency and hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor—all in service of patients.

This position reports to the SVP of Global Commercial Development and will serve as a core member of the GCD Leadership Team.

Dow Jones Energy is a leading global energy intelligence business providing trusted price reporting from our specialist Price Reporting Agency (PRA) OPIS, Chemical Market Analytics (CMA) and McCloskey, proprietary data, market intelligence, news and research to help customers navigate increasingly interconnected energy markets. Through our specialist businesses, Dow Jones Energy makes it easier to discover and access trusted expertise spanning oil and gas, chemicals, refined fuels, coal, electric vehicle infrastructure and renewables. Our specialist businesses combine rigorous pricing methodologies with world-class human judgment to deliver the trusted intelligence and specialist insight customers need to make confident decisions.

**About the Role**

The Director of Business Optimization & Operational Excellence will play a pivotal role in transforming commercial operations into a highly efficient, value-impacting engine. Reporting directly to the VP of Operational Excellence, this role is tasked with managing the Business Optimization team driving the end-to-end Customer Journey process improvement, strengthening commercial and commercial operations execution, and enabling sustainable business growth. In addition, implement systematic collection of VOC across customer facing functions for actionable insights.The successful candidate will leverage Lean management frameworks, process mapping methodologies, automation technologies, and advanced Salesforce CRM optimization to eliminate friction across commercial workflows. Furthermore, this role will champion cross-functional alignment and operational efficiency across critical commercial partnering functions, including Sales Excellence, Customer Service, Sales Coordination, RevOps, Marketing, Billing and Legal teams.

* Process Mapping, Streamlining & Lean Optimization

* Workflow Documentation: Map existing end-to-end commercial operations, creating comprehensive As-Is process maps, standard operating procedures, and To-Be future-state designs.
* Lean & Continuous Improvement: Apply Lean, Six Sigma, and Kaizen methodologies to identify operational bottlenecks, redundancies, waste, and friction points across departments.
* Optimization Execution: Redesign Lead to Cash workflows to reduce cycle times, minimize error rates, eliminate rework, and enhance overall service delivery quality.
* Customer Journey Optimization: Partner with marketing, sales and sales operations to design, evaluate, and refine automated lead journeys that nurture prospects and generate high-intent sales leads.

* Salesforce CRM Maximization & Commercial Enablement

* Salesforce Utilization & Optimization: Serve as the primary business bridge between commercial teams and Salesforce administrators to enhance user adoption, workflow automation, lead-to-cash process efficiency, and pipeline management.
* Commercial Execution & Sales Enablement: Streamline sales workflows, lead routing, opportunity tracking, and CPQ (Configure, Price, Quote) integration to remove administrative burden from sales.
* Manage the implementation of digital adoption training tools (WalkMe).

* Process Innovation, Digital Transformation & Automation

* Automation Tool Integration: Identify and champion innovative technology solutions, including Robotic Process Automation (RPA), AI-driven workflows, smart forms, and document management automation.
* Digital Workflow Solutions: Modernize manual, e-mail based, paper-based, or spreadsheet-heavy tasks across commercial and support operations into automated digital tools.

* Cross-Functional Support Team Operational Efficiency

* Commercial Support Optimization: Drive operational excellence across Customer Service, Contract Support, and Sales Coordinator teams to align service metrics with commercial growth objectives.
* Customer Service & Order Execution: Enhance ticket resolution workflows, order management, and inquiry handling to improve Customer Satisf

record.ROLE_TEXT:
**Sr. Director, Club Operations - Boston**

Overview

**WHO WE ARE**

Equinox is a category of one, setting the global standard for luxury health, wellness, and hospitality. Our spaces are intentionally elevated, our standards uncompromising, and our expectations high. We attract people who take pride in excellence, care deeply about quality, and want to be part of something that feels different the moment you walk through the door.

We are builders, operators, and innovators who believe great environments and meaningful human connection change lives. Diversity, belonging, and ownership aren’t slogans here, they’re how we work. At Equinox, colleagues don’t just support the business; they shape the future of wellness. Because for us, it’s not fitness. It’s life.

**WHAT WE DO**

We create premium, immersive experiences where performance, hospitality, design, and human connection converge-and every detail matters. This is not a traditional fitness environment. It is a place where high standards, accountability, and pride in craft define the work.

Fueled by an entrepreneurial mindset, we trust our people with real responsibility and real impact. Growth is earned through action, learning is hands‑on, and careers are built by those who want to operate at the highest level. At Equinox, we don’t just offer opportunities-we offer long‑term pathways for people who want to do meaningful work in an environment that expects more and delivers more.

Job Description 
Reporting to the Regional Vice President of Operations, the Sr. Club Operations Director will be responsible for maintaining Equinox Standards across an assigned market area. This leadership role demands a deep understanding of Club management, with a focus on driving sales, enhancing the member experience, and ensuring that the Equinox’s luxury image is consistently upheld. The Sr. Director of Club Operations will lead and manage a group of General Managers and will with closely to lead Club and Ancillary teams, implement strategic initiatives and hold teams accountable for delivering results. The Sr. Director of Club Operations will have a strong presence in driving membership sales, maintaining operational excellence, and fostering a culture of success, guided by our core values.

**Operations Management**

* Member experience and satisfaction
* Facilities maintenance and cleanliness
* Staff management and development
* Group fitness programming
* Personal training programs
* Compliance with safety and hygiene standards

**Financial Performance**

* Achieve revenue targets and control expenses
* Manage budgets and analyze financial reports
* Identify opportunities for growth and profitability

**Team Leadership**

* Recruit, hire, train, and develop department managers
* Foster a positive and collaborative work environment
* Motivate and inspire staff to achieve goals
* Conduct performance reviews and provide feedback

**Member Engagement**

* Build relationships with members and address their needs
* Resolve member complaints and issues
* Create a welcoming and inclusive atmosphere
* Brand Standards:
* Ensure adherence to Equinox brand guidelines and service standards
* Maintain a high level of professionalism and presentation

\*

* Implement marketing and promotional initiatives

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Daily**

* Team Engagement - huddles, meetings, workouts
* Coaching GMs - Focusing on leadership and strategy
* Club Visit and Walk Through - 1-2 clubs/day
* 1on1 business meetings with GMs, AGMs and Regional Leaders

* Review clubs appointments - previous day activities (prospects, sales, equifits)
* Structured 1on1 GM Meetings - 30 min in person at least 2-3x/week
* Schedule Accountability - Checking schedules on arcon, verifying in person

**Monthly**

* GM & AGM development - ensuring it's happening (either directly or GM is delivering), schedule, reviews, learning

* People Pipeline - Staffing for future needs, identifying talent for growth
* Sales Strategy and Acco

**About Tufts Medicine**

Tufts Medicine brings together the best of academic and community medicine to deliver exceptional, connected and accessible care. Comprised of Tufts Medical Center, the principal teaching hospital of Tufts University and the Tufts University School of Medicine, Lowell General Hospital, MelroseWakefield Hospital, Lawrence Memorial Hospital of Medford, Care at Home, and an integrated network of 2,300 physicians, we treat the most complex conditions, keep our communities healthy and bring research breakthroughs to life.

**Job Overview**

This position reports to the Vice President of the Community Practice Operations (South and West) & Network Integration and serves as a key leader within Ambulatory at Tufts Medicine. The role provides operational and strategic oversight across the West region and in alignment with Ambulatory within the broader Tufts network.

In addition, this leader will oversee the Tufts Medicine Multi-Specialty location in Framingham, as well as Norfolk, including not only operations, but also growth within these practices. Operating within a collaborative leadership model and with a focus on service excellence in the ambulatory environment, this position is accountable for:

* Ensuring high-quality patient access and experience
* Driving financial performance and profitability
* Optimizing all revenue cycle processes
* Advancing strategic initiatives across the region and potentially across Ambulatory as a whole, when designated

2. Seven (7) years of healthcare management or practice management experience working directly with physicians and practice members.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

1. Master’s degree in business, healthcare, or a related field.

2. Ten (10) years of healthcare management or practice management experience working directly with physicians and practice members.

1. Directs the practice operations managers in the day-to-day operations of their employed outpatient physician practices to ensure each practice is meeting optimal operational efficiency, fiscal stability and patient/employee satisfaction.

**Job Overview**

The Director of Operations provides executive leadership across operations and business management, aligning day-to-day execution with strategic priorities. This role oversees financial and budget management, guides projects and organizational change, and advances process improvement to support effective, sustainable business performance.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead operations management and coordinate business activities.
* Set strategic direction and translate priorities into plans.
* Oversee financial management and budget planning.
* Guide project management from planning through delivery.
* Identify opportunities for process improvement and efficiency.
* Lead change management and support effective adoption.
* Your impact: Strong operational and financial oversight helps teams use resources effectively and deliver on business priorities.

**Qualifications**

* Demonstrated capability in operations and business management.
* Executive leadership skills and sound strategic judgment.
* Knowledge of financial management and budget oversight.
* Project management skills, including planning and coordination.
* Ability to assess processes and guide improvements.
* Clear communication and change leadership skills.

Pay: $141,100.00 - $207,800.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Employee discount
* Flexible schedule
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Professional development assistance
* Referral program
* Relocation assistance
* Retirement plan
* Tuition reimbursement
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Miami Beach, FL 33139

About David AI
David AI is the first audio data research company. We bring an R&D approach to data–developing datasets with the same rigor AI labs bring to models. Our mission is to bring AI into the real world, and we believe audio is the gateway. Speech is versatile, accessible, and human—it fits naturally into everyday life. As audio AI advances and new use cases emerge, high-quality training data is the bottleneck. This is where David AI comes in.

David AI was founded in 2024 by a team of former Scale AI engineers and operators. In less than a year, we’ve brought on most FAANG companies and AI labs as customers. We recently raised a $50M Series B from Meritech, NVIDIA, Jack Altman (Alt Capital), Amplify Partners, First Round Capital and other Tier 1 investors.

Our team is sharp, humble, ambitious, and tight-knit. We’re looking for the best research, engineering, product, and operations minds to join us on our mission to push the frontier of audio AI.


About our Data Operations team
Our Data Operations team powers David AI's Data Factory, transforming raw audio into high-quality training datasets for leading AI labs. Our mandate is to spin up new data pipelines and run them at a massive scale. This means starting from a model capability we want a model to unlock, experimenting with different shapes of data and collection strategies, and validating them with researchers. Once an approach works, we industrialize it, building pipelines that can process audio with reliability, quality, and efficiency. We are relentless operators who thrive in ambiguity, equally comfortable prototyping novel workflows as we are managing large-scale production systems.


About this role
As Head of Quality Assurance Operations, you'll own quality for every dataset David AI ships including but not limited to conversational, TTS, and transcription data, and manage David AI’s relationships with the global contingent workforce, comprising independent contractors and vendor-supplied contributors. You'll report to the Head of Operations and be located in the US.


In this role, you will

 - Own the quality bar across all data ops, including quality standards, calibration, consistency and on-time delivery of datasets

 - Design the quality review structure, organized by language and region, so every dataset gets consistent quality coverage

 - Audit and review the quality of delivered work product across languages, keeping quality benchmarks consistent globally

 - Run quality in languages you don't speak through deliverables from native-speaker and cross-language gold sets

 - Plan capacity against production ramps and own contingent workforce sourcing across many countries, ensuring each engagement is structured and classified correctly under local law

 - Build and own dashboards for quality, throughput, and cost efficiency

 - Manage David AI’s relationships with staffing vendors, service providers, and employer-of-record partners
 

Your background looks like

 - 7 to 10+ years in operations, including 3+ in senior leadership roles

 - You've run quality operations for large contingent workforce networks across multiple countries

 - You've owned quality at scale, across calibration, capacity planning, and spend efficiency

 - You built the system yourself, from tooling to contingent workforce sourcing at scale

 - Speech, audio, or linguistic data experience is a strong plus


VISAS

We sponsor international candidates across several visa types, including H-1B transfers, H-1B1, O-1, E-3, and TN. We also hire candidates on STEM OPT. If you’re on OPT, we’ll want to confirm you have a path to one of the visas listed above before your OPT ends. While we can’t guarantee any individual outcome, we’ve successfully sponsored teammates from all over the world.

JOB DESCRIPTION:

The Compensation Director, Aircraft Engineering and Manufacturing, serves as the strategic compensation leader for the Aircraft division, providing enterprise-level oversight for compensation programs supporting manufacturing, production, operations, supply chain, logistics, customer success, and skilled trades. This role defines compensation strategy for large, complex employee populations while ensuring programs are competitive, scalable, compliant, and aligned with business objectives. 

As the organization's subject matter expert for manufacturing and operations compensation, the Director partners closely with business leaders, Px Business Partners, Finance, and Legal to design compensation programs that enable business growth, talent attraction, workforce scalability, and operational excellence. 

The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in manufacturing compensation strategy, non-exempt workforce design, market intelligence, and executive consulting, with a demonstrated ability to influence enterprise decisions and build compensation frameworks that support rapidly growing operations. 

What you'll do:

Compensation Strategy & Enterprise Leadership 

 - Develop and lead the compensation strategy supporting Aircraft manufacturing, production, operations, supply chain, logistics, customer success, and skilled trades populations.  

 - Serve as the SME on manufacturing and operations compensation, shaping long-term compensation philosophy and governance.  

 - Partner with business leadership to align compensation strategy with business growth, workforce planning, organizational design, and operational priorities.  

 - Drive compensation initiatives supporting facility expansions, new business models, geographic growth, and workforce transformation.  

Manufacturing & Operations Compensation 

 - Lead the design and evolution of compensation structures supporting large non-exempt employee populations.  

 - Establish wage structures, geographic differentials, shift premium strategies, progression frameworks, and other compensation programs that balance external competitiveness with internal equity.  

 - Oversee market pricing methodologies utilizing Radford, Mercer, WTW, and specialized manufacturing compensation surveys alongside complementary market intelligence.  

 - Develop innovative compensation approaches to attract and retain highly competitive manufacturing, technical, and operational talent. 

Executive Partnership & Business Consulting 

 - Serve as the trusted compensation advisor to Aircraft executives and business leaders.  

 - Consult on organization design, workforce investments, location strategy, and talent acquisition decisions with significant financial and organizational impact in partnership with the Px Business Partner.  

 - Provide strategic guidance on compensation implications of organizational changes, acquisitions, new facilities, and business expansion.  

 - Present compensation recommendations and analyses to executive leadership with clear business rationale and risk assessments.  

Compensation Analytics & Insights 

 - Lead enterprise compensation analyses including market competitiveness, pay equity, workforce cost modeling, and incentive effectiveness.  

 - Translate complex compensation

record.ROLE_TEXT:
ADM – Soy Crush
 
 
This is an exempt level position.
 
 
**Position Summary**
This key operational role is responsible for leading all aspects of the operations at a soy white flake crush processing facility with an integrated refinery. You will have a leading role in driving excellence, developing and implementing programs and procedures, and developing a manufacturing team. You set and maintain ADM’s high standards for Safety and Quality for all departments while maintaining production and efficiency excellence. A good communicator who can nurture extraordinary interdepartmental, commercial and customer relationships will be most successful. He/she will have the ability to identify and conclusively solve problems as they arise, develop and supervise capital improvement projects and maintain records in accordance with established ADM policies.
 
 
The Plant Manager reports directly to the Director of Regional Operations and leads a site with approximately 40 colleagues.
 
 
**Job Responsibilities**

* Lead a soy white flake crush plant and refinery.
* Develop a high performance team by engaging, coaching and developing team members, and by driving accountability and ownership at all levels.
* Responsible for environmental, health, safety, quality, efficiency and production of the plant.
* Responsible for meeting production requirements safely, reliably, and efficiently.
* Lead and support performance excellence initiatives.
* Provide technical knowledge for processes and equipment to obtain performance leveraging ADM Centers of Excellence.
* Maintain cost controls and oversee budgets in each department.
* Utilize production personnel and equipment in a safe and efficient manner to obtain maximum capacity and performance with optimum yields and quality product.
* Develop and implement a five year capital plan in alignment with the business strategy.

**Health, Safety & Environmental:**

* Maintain the license to operate by developing a strong site safety culture and by ensuring adherence to safety laws, regulations, rules and sound practices.
* Act as a role model for safety.
* Work with the Safety and Environmental Center of Excellence and the regional and local management on the continued development and implementation of environmental, health, and safety programs, policies and procedures.
* Coordinate and contribute in audits, prioritizing and tracking completion of findings.
* Ensure that unsafe behavior and conditions are corrected.
* Maintain the necessary environmental, health, and safety records and documentation.

**Sanitation/Food Safety:**

* Ensure the facility maintains world-class sanitation standards.
* Continually improve and communicate food safety/sanitation/quality programs to plant supervisors and hourly employees.
* Prepare the facility for, and participate in, regulatory/third party/customer/company audits.

**Required Skills:**

* Four-year degree in a technical field, engineering degree preferred, and a minimum of four years of supervisory experience with increasing manufacturing leadership responsibility, or a minimum of six years of hands-on, increasing production leadership experience.
* Previous experience in oilseeds operations highly preferred.
* Demonstrated leadership in safety.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate for achievement and communicate effectively.
* Demonstrated coaching and leadership skills.

Excited about this role but don’t think you meet every requirement listed? We encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this role or another one of our openings.
 
 
ADM requires the successful completion of a background check.

At Bloom Energy, our vision for a world powered by clean, reliable, and affordable energy is more than just a dream—we’re making it reality.
 
 
For over two decades, we’ve been at the forefront of the global energy transition, pioneering solutions that empower critical industries to thrive in a rapidly digitizing, energy-intensive world. From revolutionizing power for AI-driven data centers to ensuring resilience for hospitals, electric grids, manufacturing facilities, and utilities, our solid oxide fuel cell (SOFC) and solid oxide electrolyzer (SOEC) technologies are redefining what’s possible by delivering energy abundance for all. With more than 30,000 fuel cell modules deployed worldwide, we are the trusted partner for Fortune 100 companies and innovators alike. Our cutting-edge solutions enable unparalleled “time-to-power” capabilities, reliability, and sustainability, ensuring our customers remain ahead in a world where soaring energy demand and intensifying energy scarcity are rapidly becoming the new norm.
 
 
At Bloom, we thrive on collaboration, bold thinking, and relentless innovation. We believe that, together, we can create a brighter, more sustainable future while tackling the most pressing challenges of the 21st century.

* Ensure manufacturing process have Control plans with CTQ, and POA built in to each station.

* Represents the organization with major customers, shareholders, the financial community, and the public.

* Promote continuous improvement initiatives for scrap reduction, reducing variation and waste, increasing profit and to improve product quality.

***For more than 100 years, Olympus has focused on making people’s lives healthier, safer and more fulfilling.***
